articleTitle: Enhanced Detection Classification via Clustering SVM for Various Robot Collaboration Task
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: We introduce an advanced, swift pattern recognition strategy for various multiple robotics during curve negotiation. This method, leveraging a sophisticated k-means clustering-enhanced Support Vector Machine algorithm, distinctly categorizes robotics into flying or mobile robots. Initially, the paradigm considers robot locations and features as quintessential parameters indicative of divergent robot patterns. Subsequently, employing the k-means clustering technique facilitates the efficient segregation and consolidation of robotic data, significantly optimizing the support vector delineation process and expediting the recognition phase. Following this preparatory phase, the SVM methodology is adeptly applied to construct a discriminative hyperplane, enabling precise classification and prognostication of the robot category. To substantiate the efficacy and superiority of the k-means framework over traditional SVM approaches, a rigorous cross-validation experiment was orchestrated, evidencing the former's enhanced performance in robot group classification.

articleTitle: Real-Time Pill Identification for the Visually Impaired Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The prevalence of mobile technology offers unique opportunities for addressing healthcare challenges, especially for individuals with visual impairments. This paper explores the development and implementation of a deep learning-based mobile application designed to assist blind and visually impaired individuals in real-time pill identification. Utilizing the YOLO framework, the application aims to accurately recognize and differentiate between various pill types through real-time image processing on mobile devices. The system incorporates Text-to-Speech (TTS) to provide immediate auditory feedback, enhancing usability and independence for visually impaired users. Our study evaluates the application's effectiveness in terms of detection accuracy and user experience, highlighting its potential to improve medication management and safety among the visually impaired community.

articleTitle: TD3 Based Collision Free Motion Planning for Robot Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of collision-free motion planning in automated navigation within complex environments. Utilizing advancements in Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) and sensor technologies like LiDAR, we propose the TD3-DWA algorithm, an innovative fusion of the traditional Dynamic Window Approach (DWA) with the Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3). This hybrid algorithm enhances the efficiency of robotic path planning by optimizing the sampling interval parameters of DWA to effectively navigate around both static and dynamic obstacles. The performance of the TD3-DWA algorithm is validated through various simulation experiments, demonstrating its potential to significantly improve the reliability and safety of autonomous navigation systems.

articleTitle: Optimising Random Forest Machine Learning Algorithms for User VR Experience Prediction Based on Iterative Local Search-Sparrow Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, an improved method for VR user experience prediction is investigated by introducing a sparrow search algorithm and a random forest algorithm improved by an iterative local search-optimised sparrow search algorithm. The study firstly conducted a statistical analysis of the data, and then trained and tested using the traditional random forest model, the random forest model improved by the sparrow search algorithm, and the random forest algorithm improved based on the iterative local search-sparrow search algorithm, respectively. The results show that the traditional random forest model has a prediction accuracy of 93% on the training set but only 73.3% on the test set, which is poor in generalisation; whereas the model improved by the sparrow search algorithm has a prediction accuracy of 94% on the test set, which is improved compared with the traditional model. What is more noteworthy is that the improved model based on the iterative local search-sparrow search algorithm achieves 100% accuracy on both the training and test sets, which is significantly better than the other two methods. These research results provide new ideas and methods for VR user experience prediction, especially the improved model based on the iterative local search-sparrow search algorithm performs well and is able to more accurately predict and classify the user's VR experience. In the future, the application of this method in other fields can be further explored, and its effectiveness can be verified through real cases to promote the development of AI technology in the field of user experience.

articleTitle: Enhancing Seq2Seq Models for Role-Oriented Dialogue Summary Generation Through Adaptive Feature Weighting and Dynamic Statistical Conditioninge
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Role-oriented dialogue summarization techniques are designed to generate corresponding summaries for different roles in a dialogue. Although existing techniques can handle structured dialogues, it remains a challenge to effectively adapt to role transformation and real-time adjustment of discourse importance in changing dialog scenarios. To this end, we propose a new method called Adaptive Feature Weighting with Dynamic Statistical Conditioning (ADSC), which dynamically adjusts the weights of the roles and discourses in a dialog, and flexibly responds to real-time changes in the dialogue content, especially in terms of role transformation and discourse importance adjustment. In addition, in order to adapt to the input of uncertain number of roles, we introduce Role Prompts to guide the model to generate corresponding summaries according to different roles. We validate the effectiveness of the ADSC method on two publicly available datasets, CSDS and MC, and demonstrate the advantages of combining the method with the Seq2Seq model. The experimental results show that the ADSC method significantly improves the performance of these models on the dialog summarization task, and especially performs best when combined with the BART model.

articleTitle: A Novel Feature Fusion-Based and Complex Contextual Model for Smoking Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Smoking target detection plays a central role in contributing to the improvement of public health and fire prevention. Given the limitations of existing techniques in multi-scale fusion, feature fusion efficiency, and accurate extraction of key targets in complex data environments, this paper proposes an advanced and efficient innovative algorithmic model-BEC-YOLO, which focuses on solving these challenges with a view to improving the overall detection performance. In this paper, BiFPN is firstly adopted to realize multi-level feature fusion in order to make up for the shortcomings of existing target detection algorithms in feature extraction and recognition, which effectively improves the feature fusion effect. Then, ECA is introduced to significantly improve the efficiency and accuracy of key target information extraction in complex data environments. Finally, the feature representation and fusion efficiency are further enhanced by introducing CBAM. The experimental findings demonstrate a notable 5.3% enhancement in mAP when comparing the approach in this paper to the original model. This highlights the accuracy of the BEC-YOLO model for detecting smoking in intricate settings.

articleTitle: GGM-YOLOV8: Strawberry Disease Detection Model Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that strawberry disease detection model requires a lot of computation and costs much to deploy on mobile terminal, a lightweight disease detection model was proposed in this paper. First, GSConv was used to replace ordinary convolution at the neck position of YOLOv8, and the C2f module at this position was replaced with VoV-GSCSP to reduce the computational load of the model. Secondly, C2f-Ghost is used to replace the C2f network of the backbone network, which not only reduces the number of model parameters, but also improves the ability of the model to capture information at different spatial locations over long distances. Finally, by adding Multidimensional Collaborative Attention, the learning ability of the model is improved. The experimental results show that the mean Average Precision of the improved YOLOv8 for six strawberry diseases reaches 95.8%, which is 1.8% higher than the original model, and the floating point operations decreases by 24.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>. The improved model not only improves the accuracy of disease detection, but also improves the real-time detection efficiency of the model in the field, which is conducive to the mobile deployment of the model in the later stage.

articleTitle: Design Application of Poetry Communication Platform Based on HanLP
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the popularity of intelligent devices such as computers and mobile Internet, many traditional cultures are developing towards the integration of digital information and intelligence. Establishing a cultural digital platform combined with information technology is of great significance for the development of digital culture industry. This paper is based on HanLP natural language processing technology, combined with poetry and software system characteristics. The poetry communication platform based on HanLP is designed, which has the characteristic modules of poetry and related information retrieval, management and intelligent recommendation.

articleTitle: Speech Enhancement Method Based on Generative Adversarial Network and Convolutional Block Attention Module
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Current generative adversarial networks ignore the importance of information in space and among different convolutional channels when dealing with speech enhancement tasks, and do not adequately resolve features at different scales. Based on this, a speech enhancement method based on generative adversarial networks and convolutional attention modules is proposed. The generator can parse features at different time scales and a convolutional block attention module is introduced in the downsampling block of the generator. It consists of two sub-modules, the channel attention mechanism and the spatial attention mechanism, to extract more critical information in both channel and spatial dimensions. Using the method of training generative adversarial networks, the scores of the noise-canceled speech by this method are significantly improved in all the metrics when compared to the Wave-U-net model on the publicly available dataset. The improvement is 11.25%, 3.7%, and 8.8% on the three main metrics, namely PESQ, CBAK, and CSIG, respectively.

articleTitle: Mix of Experts Language Model for Named Entity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Named Entity Recognition (NER) is an essential steppingstone in the field of natural language processing. Although promising performance has been achieved by various distantly supervised models, we argue that distant supervision inevitably introduces incomplete and noisy annotations, which may mislead the model training process. To address this issue, we propose a robust NER model named BOND-MoE based on Mixture of Experts (MoE). Instead of relying on a single model for NER prediction, multiple models are trained and ensembled under the Expectation-Maximization (EM) framework, so that noisy supervision can be dramatically alleviated. In addition, we introduce a fair assignment module to balance the document-model assignment process. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets show that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance compared with other distantly supervised NER.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High Precision Clock Synchronization System Based on RT1064
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To realize the high-precision clock synchronization of various types of control equipment in the industrial process control network, a high-precision clock synchronizing system is designed and implemented. The system uses RT1064 microprocessor as the core, combined with ieee1588v2 high-accuracy clock synchronization protocol, and uses the MAC kernel integrated in rt1064 to support hardware timestamp function to achieve high-precision time synchronization between devices; Finally, the test verification platform is built to test and verify the accuracy. The test results show that the clock synchronization accuracy is within ± 400ns after the system runs stably, which meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Target Detection Algorithm Based on Infrared Visible Light Feature Level Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the widespread application of drones, the safety threats brought by their low altitude flight are increasing, and there is an urgent need for effective anti drone technology to ensure public safety and personal privacy. This article studies target detection technology based on feature level fusion to improve the accuracy and robustness of drone detection. This article introduces a drone target detection algorithm that combines visible light and infrared images, and constructs an unregistered dual-mode drone target dataset to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm on the unregistered drone target dataset, providing ideas for improving the detection performance of unregistered dual-mode drone targets.

articleTitle: Joint Resource Allocation and Trajectory Optimization for Computation Offloading in UAV-Enabled Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we study a UAV-enabled MEC system to address the issue of energy depletion. Ground Devices (GDs) within its service area can benefit from computation offloading provided by the UAV outfitted with an MEC server. By simultaneously optimizing the UAV's offloading locations for each GD, resource allocation, and UAV trajectory for the suggested scenario, we hope to reduce the UAV's overall energy usage. Two sub-problems are derived from the formulated optimization problem. The first step involves identifying the places for offloading and allocating resources. The Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) technique is then utilized to obtain the solution. In the latter case, we use the Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN) algorithm to solve the offloading decision matrix of the UAV. Comparing the suggested system to existing benchmark methods, simulation results show that the UAV's energy usage is greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Optimization strategies for integrating electric vehicle energy storage systems with the new energy Internet: A focus on demand forecasting and grid response
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This research aims to explore the effective integration path of electric vehicle energy storage systems with the new energy Internet to enhance the efficiency and intelligence of the energy system. The study establishes a fusion framework for integrating electric vehicle energy storage with the new energy Internet and details the data collection and processing process, including demand prediction and management strategies through the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network model. This research utilizes basic and mature data mining methods such as data cleaning, data normalization, Fourier transforms, and Principal Component Analysis (PCA). The results demonstrate that through intelligent electricity pricing adjustments and optimized energy storage and discharge strategies, the grid load during peak periods is significantly reduced, the contribution rate of renewable energy is increased, and a high satisfaction rate for electric vehicle charging needs is maintained. Therefore, while deep learning technology is applied for demand forecasting in this study, it does not encompass the core methodology for the integration framework described herein. This finding clarifies the supporting role of deep learning in this context, providing a basis for the optimization decisions rather than being the central feature of the integration strategy.

articleTitle: Research on GMI-STBC Precoding in Ground-to-Air Data Link
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The ground-to-air data link system is used for the connection between the airborne platform and the ground radio system, which needs to have the advantages of high reliability, strong anti-interference ability and high transmission rate. The multipath effect exerts a substantial influence on communication quality when the airborne platform and the ground station are at low elevation. To address this issue, this article proposes the GMI-STBC precoding which utilizes channel block diagonalization and space-time coding to ensure reliable transmission of ground-to-air data link within the same time-frequency resource. Channel block diagonalization transforms the channels between multiple airborne platforms and the ground station into parallel sub-channels that do not interfere with each other and STBC coding sends multiple copies of the data stream which are orthometric over multiple antennas to improve transmission reliability.

articleTitle: Group Intelligence Optimization Algorithm of Adaptive Trigonometric Function and T-Distributed Perturbation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO) is a leading swarm intelligence optimization algorithm that restores the predation behavior of gray wolves and uses their collective cooperation to achieve algorithm optimization. However, the traditional GWO algorithm has limitations regarding optimization accuracy and convergence speed. To address these problems, this paper introduces an innovative GWO variant, NTGWO, which combines adaptive trigonometric functions and T-distribution perturbation strategies. By integrating these two strategies into the GWO framework, not only the algorithm's capacity for a wide-ranging search is enhanced, the local optimization trap is avoided effectively, but also a new solution for solving complex optimization problems is provided, and the progress of swarm intelligence optimization algorithms is promoted. To verify the effectiveness of NTGWO, this paper conducted a comprehensive evaluation using 12 standard test functions and compared it to GWO, NOA, DBO, and SCA. The experimental results show that NTGWO has remarkable performance advantages.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of VxWorks Compatibility Library Based on Xenomai
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: VxWorks real-time operating system can be simulated and implemented based on Xenomai. Compared to the VxWorks application API reference document released by Wind River System, the VxWorks Compatibility Library interfaces are incomplete which have been simulated and implemented based on Xenomai. This paper renovates Xenomai and supplements the implementation of the missing interfaces such as the named message queue, read-write semaphore and SigLib to improve the VxWorks Compatibility Library, so that VxWorks applications can be smoothly migrated to Linux. The relevant functional designs are proved to be complete and the VxWorks Compatibility Library works well.

articleTitle: Emergency Vehicle Priority Strategy Based on the Cellular Automata Model
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To address the issue of emergency vehicle delays in congested urban areas, this paper proposes a novel priority strategy for emergency vehicles based on the V2X environment. Implemented within a newly developed dual-lane cellular automaton model featuring emergency vehicles, this strategy leverages real-time information acquisition to allow civilian vehicles to change lanes immediately when conditions permit, significantly reducing travel time for emergency vehicles and minimizing the impact on social vehicles traffic speed. Simulation results confirm that this strategy substantially enhances the efficiency of emergency vehicle operations in urban areas, demonstrating significant practicality and potential for application. Moreover, the implementation of this strategy contributes valuable theoretical and practical insights to the field of intelligent transportation systems, paving the way for future advancements in urban traffic management and emergency response optimization.

articleTitle: The Fuzzy Control of LED Lights in Machine Vision System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the vast applications of artificial intelligence technology in industrial manufacture domains, lots of machine vision system are used in the fields. Due to different lights conditions on different sites, it costed many times to adjust the machine vision system to a good performance. To decrease the adjustment time a fuzzy control method to automatically adjust the lights illuminance was proposed. In the method the industrial camera captured image was set as the control target. And the real-time quality assessment of the image was designed with the combination of objective method and subjective method. The lights illuminance of the machine vision system was automatically adjusted using the fuzzy logic to get qualified image satisfying the post image process requirements. The fuzzy logic was designed and verified using Matlab and the whole approach was practiced in a machine vision training device. The whole approach was proven feasible and provided valuable reference to the similar engineering applications.

articleTitle: Pseudorange Bias Correction of BeiDou-3 Satellite Navigation Signals in the Localization of Large-Scale Power Distribution Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Using only the correction parameters between ISCs (Inter signal correction) signals to establish a pseudorange offset correction model is susceptible to changes in receiver bandwidth, resulting in excessive pseudorange offset. Therefore, it is necessary to design a new method for correcting the pseudorange offset of Beidou-3 satellite navigation signals in the positioning of large-scale power distribution equipment. That is to say, the navigation signal of the Beidou-3 satellite in the positioning of large power distribution equipment was processed, and the pseudo range deviation correction parameters of the Beidou-2 satellite navigation signal were adjusted using BOC, thus achieving the correction of the pseudo range deviation of the Beidou-3 navigation signal. The experimental results show that the pseudorange deviation of the Beidou-3 satellite navigation signal in the positioning of large power distribution equipment is relatively low between different dates. This method has good correction effect, accuracy, and certain application value, making a certain contribution to reducing the risk of satellite navigation signal distortion.

articleTitle: An Efficient ADMM-Based Penalized Decoding Algorithm for Binary LDPC Code
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: LDPC decoding algorithm based on the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) technique has increased much attentions because of its outstanding decoding performance. To enhancing performance advantages of ADMM decoding in practical application, a main challenge is to design an efficient penalty function and then customize an accelerating decoding algorithm. To address this issue, in this paper we propose an improved penalized decoding problem based on a segmented penalty function (SPF), and then develop an efficient ADMM algorithm via optimizing variable updating to solve this SPF-based decoding model. Experimental simulations demonstrate that the proposed algorithm effectively reduces the number of iterations while achieving better error-correction performance, when compared to the state-of-the-art ADMM-based decoding algorithms.

articleTitle: A Motion Compensation Method for a One-Transmitter Multiple-Receiver Mobile Radar System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The mobile radar platform will lead to defocusing of the range-Doppler spectra of the echo signal, which will reduce the effect of multi-pulse coherent accumulation and target detection performance. In the one-transmitter multiple-receiver mode, the influencing factors of defocusing phenomenon are more complicated. In this paper, the influence of the complex motion of the radar platform on the multi-pulse coherent accumulation of the echo signal is studied based on the one-transmitter multiple-receiver mobile radar system. Combined with the principle of Radon-Fourier transform, a motion compensation method suitable for the one-transmitter multiple-receiver mobile radar system is proposed. Theoretical derivation and simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively compensate the phase shift between pulses caused by radar platform motion and achieve better energy accumulation effect in low SNR environment.

articleTitle: OV-AS: Zero-Shot/Few-Shot Open-Vocabulary Anomaly Segmentation Based on CLIP
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Existing anomaly detection methods mainly focus on unsupervised learning, resulting in low generalization and single type segmentation. Hence, we introduce open-vocabulary detection pattern into anomaly segmentation field to achieve multi-semantic segmentation and propose a zero-shot/few-shot open-vocabulary anomaly segmentation OV-AS based on CLIP. (1) In zero-shot, introduce pretraining on the open-vocabulary segmentation models for specific anomaly domain knowledge learning based on an extracted Anomaly Domain-General dataset. Then, introduce fine-tuning on the image encoder of CLIP for further narrowing the gap with target domain. (2) In few-shot, introduce few-anomaly-shot learning on target datasets. Results show that in zero-shot, our model achieves 35.7/13.3 F1-max on MVTec-AD/VisA benchmarks, essentially surpassing state-of-the-art. In few-shot, our model achieves 43.0 mIoU on VISION benchmark under 10-shot, comparable to supervised learning.

articleTitle: Comfort Shoulder (Rhomboid Major) Muscles Chair Identifier System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Nowadays, Sitting is one of the frequent activities of humans. particularly with the rise of office work, which is leading to an increase in the sitting periods for many individuals. Research highlights the importance of studying sitting posture to enhance seat quality, correct sitting methods, and prevent various health issues like neck and shoulder strains, etc. This article focuses on designing an IoT-based system that enables web-based data visualization without specialized software that can enable distance sampling. Through temperature sensors (DS18b20 and SHT11) and an FSR sensor, the system can identify distinct patterns in the main rhomboid muscles (the most important muscles of humans). The results show a significant relationship between individuals' body mass (BMI) and the observed muscle patterns, highlighting the importance of this correlation for researchers and industry designers alike.

articleTitle: Design of Mutual Recognition and Interworking of Electronic Seals Based on Alliance Chain
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper aims to design a mutual recognition and interoperability mechanism of electronic seal based on alliance chain, so as to solve the problems of mutual recognition and interoperability caused by many domestic electronic seal issuers, non-uniform standards, and various carrier forms. By studying the commercial cryptographic algorithm, collaborative signature technology and alliance chain technology, this paper proposed an electronic seal alliance chain model that could realize national mutual recognition and mutual communication. The model allowed digital certificates issued by different certification agencies to be bound with electronic seals through the trust source mechanism of certification authorities, so as to realize national mutual recognition and verification. Aiming at the limitations of the existing electronic seal system, this paper proposes an innovative technical solution, which is of great significance for promoting the development of digital economy and improving the efficient operation of government and business processes.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Planning Assistant APP Base on Android
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This article adopts the C/S architecture and designs and implements a planning assistant APP based on Android. Java language is used for UI design and development on Android Studio, with SQLite database for local data storage on the client side. The server is built on the Spring Boot framework, using MySQL as the server database, and data communication between the two ends is carried out via HTTP protocol to provide functions such as data reception and storage. This APP's main feature is sharing plans through the internet, using group pressure as a counterforce to encourage people to take actions. In the current trend of time refinement, it is a promising lifestyle and learning APP that helps people organize their plans and improve efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Spatial Target Operation Data Analysis Technology Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This article briefly introduces the method of analyzing spatial target operation data based on big data, with the aim of solving the problem of insufficient means of analyzing and mining potential pattern information from massive spatial target data, spatial weather data, and observation system operation data. This method studied the design ideas and implementation methods of target behavior association rule mining algorithms, temporal rule mining algorithms, and clustering analysis algorithms, achieving the effect of quickly converging the search process and quickly finding potentially valuable rule information, providing support for the effective utilization of space target operation data and the formulation of space security response plans.

articleTitle: A New Data-Free Knowledge Distillation Method for Non-IID Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is an emerging distributed machine learning approach. It enables a server to aggregate model parameters from local users iteratively without requiring access to original data, thus maintaining data privacy. A persistent challenge in FL is the heterogeneity of data, which can slow convergence and impair the performance of the aggregated model. Addressing this, recent advancements in data-free knowledge distillation have shown promise. However, existing techniques often necessitate the transfer of private label distributions to the server, limiting their practical application. Therefore, this paper presents an innovative approach based on data-free knowledge distillation where generator and global model will be trained against each other. The generator is tasked with producing samples that are indistinguishable by the global model, fostering knowledge transfer from local to global models. Concurrently, the global model learns to replicate the outputs of the local models. This study also introduces a feature matching loss that enhances the training of the generator. By evaluating on various datasets, the proposed method shows a substantial performance improvement compared to previous methods.

articleTitle: Improved ResNet-50 Model for AI Image Recognition Based on Multi-Scale Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Accurate recognition of AI-generated images is critical for information security and disinformation prevention in the media. Traditional image recognition models face challenges in recognizing images produced by advanced generation techniques, which may affect their accuracy and application scope. To address this issue, this paper proposes an improved ResNet-50 model, which significantly improves the ability to distinguish AI-generated images from real images by introducing a two-channel pooling layer and a multi-scale attention mechanism. The experimental results show that the model performs well in the image classification task with an accuracy of 99.13%, which is significantly higher than other comparative models. In addition, this study also conducted ablation experiments on the model to verify the respective contributions of the dual-channel pooling layer and the multi-scale attention mechanism to the performance improvement. These improvements make the model suitable for high-precision AI false image recognition tasks.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Bearings Based on the Fusion of 1D-CNN and Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: As industrial automation continues to advance, bearing faults have become one of the significant causes leading to mechanical equipment failures, potentially resulting in substantial economic losses. Traditional fault diagnosis methods often struggle to effectively address increasingly complex fault patterns. This study proposes a method for bearing fault diagnosis based on the fusion of one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) and random forest algorithm. Our approach combines the ability of 1D-CNN to capture local patterns in time-series data and the high performance of random forest in classification tasks. We conducted experiments on the bearing dataset from the Case Western Reserve University. The experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms other popular diagnostic methods across multiple evaluation metrics, particularly in terms of recall, where it significantly surpasses other methods. This provides an efficient and reliable tool for bearing fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: An Adaptive MAC Protocol for Underwater Acoustic Networks Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Underwater acoustic networks (UWANs) faces many challenges, such as long propagation delay, complex dynamic environment and limited node energy. To address these challenges, this paper uses long propagation delay characteristics of UWANs to develop a media access control (MAC) protocol based on Dueling Double Deep Q-network (D3QN) algorithm with delay reward, called DR-D3QN-MA protocol, which aims to allocate time slots reasonably for intelligence node. The DR-D3QN-MA protocol uses the D3QN algorithm to enable the network to quickly converge to the optimal value function and improve the calculation accuracy of the Q value. At the same time, a training mechanism based on variance characteristics is proposed to make intelligence node better adapt to underwater dynamic environment and reduce node energy consumption. The simulation results show that DR-D3QN-MA protocol can coexist with other protocols, and the intelligence node can use the idle time slot. Compared with the same type of Delay-Reward Deep Reinforcement Learning Multiple Access (DR-DLMA) protocol, DR-D3QN-MA protocol has better performance in system throughput, dynamic adaptability and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Computing Power Scheduling Method Based on Long-Term Workload Prediction for Computing Power Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Users' requests for the computing power often exhibit suddenness and unpredictability, which creates challenges for workload scheduling of computing power platforms. Traditional scheduling methods struggle to adapt to such situations as they typically schedule based on real-time load conditions, ignoring long-term trends in load variations. To address these limitations, we propose a computing power scheduling method based on long-term workload prediction. First, we leverage a tree structure to aggregate temporal-spatial information from multi-variate operating time-series data, effectively describing the characteristics of workload on computing power platform. Building upon Informer, we employ residual mechanisms and dilated causal convolutions to extract deep features. Additionally, we integrate Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network (WGAN) with Informer to accurately forecast future changes in workload for computing platforms, and introduce a novel training algorithm to enhance efficiency. We validate our method through experiments using real-world workload datasets, demonstrating the significant reduction in Mean Absolute Error (MAE) compared to LSTM. Furthermore, our model exhibits sensitivity to the length of encoder input sequences, indicating improved performance with longer series inputs.

articleTitle: Improved ALISTA Algorithm Based on Dense Network and Its Application to TomoSAR Building Object Height Inversion
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The TomoSAR building object height inversion is a technique that employs two-dimensional radar image data obtained from spacecraft, such as satellites, that have traversed the same area on multiple occasions. This data is used to invert the distribution of scatterers in the area in the height direction, which is essentially a sparse reconstruction problem. The deep unfolding network algorithm ALISTA represents the current advanced algorithm for TomoSAR building object height inversion. It is a combined product of the convex optimization algorithm ISTA and the deep learning technology, exhibiting the excellent performance of both with a certain degree of interpretability. The ALISTA algorithm's network structure, however, is relatively simple, consisting of a single layer with layer-by-layer connections. In comparison, deep networks possess an excellent connection structure. In this paper, we propose the incorporation of a dense connection network structure into the ALISTA algorithm, thereby creating the DBALISTA deep unfolding network algorithm, which introduces a dense structure into the ALISTA algorithm without compromising interpretability. Empirical evidence indicates that, in the context of constrained observation data, the DBALISTA algorithm exhibits superior inversion performance compared to the ALISTA algorithm.

articleTitle: An End-to-End Deep Learning Based Approach for Plant Disease Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The agricultural industry is essential in providing high-quality food and plays a significant role in growing economies and populations. Plant diseases can cause severe losses in food production and eliminate species diversity. Using automated detection techniques for diagnosing plant diseases can enhance food productivity and minimize economic losses in the early stage. Recent advancements in Deep Neural Networks have significantly enhanced the accuracy of object recognition systems. In this paper, we present an end-to-end deep learning based methodology to recognise different diseases of plants, not limited to specific plant species. We investigate the efficiency of different Visual Transformer models with the transfer learning strategy. The AI Challenger 2018 Crop Disease Detection and PlantVillage datasets are used for training and evaluation. Experimental results indicate the efficacy of our proposed approach in accurately recognizing various plant diseases.

articleTitle: Design of Integrated Verification Environment for Electronic Equipment System Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the demand for integrated verification of electronic equipment system integration, a construction plan and application mode of the system integration verification environment were proposed. Analyzed the development process of integrated verification of US military systems and the construction and application of various integrated verification environments; According to the design concept of open architecture and based on LVC joint simulation technology, an integrated verification environment system scheme for electronic equipment system integration was designed. The technical implementation path was provided according to the three-layer technical architecture of resources, services, and applications. Introduced the application mode of integrated verification environment, providing reference for industrial units, ranges, and forces to form a comprehensive testing capability that complements and validates each other in both internal and external fields.

articleTitle: Tennis Momentum: An Analytical Study of Tennis Performance Based on the CNN-LSTM-RF Model
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this study, we introduce an innovative CNN-LSTM-RF model to analyze and predict momentum shifts in tennis, using the 2023 Wimbledon Men's Singles Final as a case study. Our approach processes match data to identify key factors affecting momentum, such as serve effectiveness, player psychology, and match dynamics, employing factor analysis and the AHP-TOPSIS method for a comprehensive performance evaluation. Findings indicate a significant correlation between momentum and winning streaks, highlighting momentum's importance in influencing match outcomes. Despite its predictive success, we recognize the model's limitations and the complexity of accurately forecasting momentum shifts. This concise analysis not only demonstrates the model's utility in tennis strategy but also suggests areas for future research and model enhancement.

articleTitle: Aircraft Type Recognition Based on Fiber Optic Sensing
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Traditional aircraft type recognition mainly relies on methods such as image recognition and radar communication. In order to cope with scenarios where traditional methods fail under extreme weather conditions, this paper proposes a fiber optic sensor-based aircraft type recognition method. First, a method for estimating aircraft taxiing velocity based on Kalman filtering was proposed. Then, by combining the time difference between the waveform peaks and fitting with multiple sensor data, the distance between the nose and main landing gear of the aircraft was extracted to obtain more accurate results. Finally, by matching the calculated values of the distribution of aircraft landing gears with the actual size information of various types of aircraft, aircraft type recognition was achieved. The experimental results show that the calculated values of the aircraft size information are close to the theoretical values.

articleTitle: Traffic Prediction Based Energy Efficient Transfer for Point-to-Point Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper investigates the performance of Kalman filtering based energy-efficient transfer for nonlinear stochastic discrete-time systems and proposes a low complex traffic load prediction algorithm. Based on the historical values of traffic load, the transmitter estimates the traffic load of the current time slot. And with the predicted traffic load, the transmission power in the incoming time slot is adjusted by the transmitter adaptively. Simulations are conducted to validate the theoretical analysis results, the proposed traffic load prediction algorithm can improve the energy efficiency of the wireless networks. The prediction accuracy is also validated with the real data sets of a local base station.

articleTitle: RIS-Aided Dual-Functional Radar and Communication System Waveform Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Dual-function radar (DFRC) technology has been recognized as an emerging solution to the spectrum scarcity problem. In the intelligent reflective surface (RIS)-assisted radar and communication spectrum coexistence system, there are problems such as the radar and base station can not eliminate the interference between each other, the platform information interaction is difficult, and it can not improve the user communication quality and radar detection performance at the same time. To address these problems, an efficient method to improve radar detection performance is proposed based on a smart surface (RIS)-assisted dual-function radar and communication system (DFRC). RIS is used to coordinate the user communication quali-ty and radar detection performance, due to the non-convexity of the objective function we use an alternating iteration method to optimize the coupled variables, finally we verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm through a simulation session.

articleTitle: Real-Time Automatic Detection of Motorcycle Helmet Based on Improved YOLOv8 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the field of road traffic, the application of a motorcycle helmet detection algorithm has a significant practical impact. This paper proposes an enhanced YOLOv8-ADown-LSCD algorithm based on YOLOv8 to address the shortcomings of existing detection algorithms, namely slow detection and the occurrence of false negatives. The algorithm utilises the ADown module in place of the convolution module in the traditional downsampling process, thereby reducing the calculation amount and the size of the detection target. This approach enables the achievement of the objective of improving the detection speed. Furthermore, a new detection head, designated as LSCD, is employed in place of the original detection head of YOLOv8. This replacement results in a significant reduction in the detection parameters, while maintaining the detection speed and accuracy. Comparative experiments have demonstrated that, when utilising the same data set, the average accuracy of the enhanced algorithm can reach 0.85 mAP@0.5. Furthermore, the detection efficiency and accuracy are superior to those of other algorithms, thus meeting the requirements of road traffic systems for motorcycle helmet wearing detection.

articleTitle: EEG Technology Interface: Synchronous Online Education Assistance System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Online Education is widely used in schools and institutions due to its convenience. However, during online classes, students may lack access to instant feedback that solves their confusion, and their instructors may face difficulty in judging students' learning status to determine their level of comprehension. To realize remote real-time detection of student's learning status and improve study efficiency, this paper proposes an online education assistance system based on single-channel EEG. In this system, recorded EEG data will be upheld into a prediction model based on the Optimizable Ensemble Model, and the predicted results will be transformed into the MYSQL database. This database will provide real-time data on a developed web page. On the web page, instructors can identify students' confusion status and attention level to provide instant learning assistance, which solves students' confusion.

articleTitle: Research on Precipitation Forecasting Models Utilizing Intermediate Fusion Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Multimodal meteorological data offers a comprehensive perspective on the evolution of individual meteorological elements. Exploiting this data effectively is crucial for enhancing the accuracy of short-term (0–4 hours) precipitation forecasts. This study introduces a recurrent neural network model designed for multimodal fusion and spatiotemporal forecasting, named MFSFN. The model utilizes GPM precipitation data and reanalysis data as inputs, providing forecasts for precipitation volume and intensity over a 0–4 hour timeframe. MFSFN integrates these three data sources on a spatiotemporal scale, effectively preserving their flow of temporal and spatial information. Experimental validation on the ERA5 and GPM datasets demonstrates that MFSFN excels in predicting light, moderate, and heavy precipitation events, particularly showing superior performance in early-stage forecasts of light and moderate precipitation compared to other methodologies.

articleTitle: UAV Signal Classification Methods Design Based on Neural Network Encoder
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are becoming increasingly prevalent in various sectors such as healthcare, agriculture, environmental monitoring, disaster management, and more. Consequently, there arises a critical need to develop a robust system capable of accurately discerning UAV signals in complex environments. This paper intends to present a novel UAV signal recognition system predicated on the classification of signals emitted by both the UAV itself and its controller. Leveraging the Wavelet transform, this system extracts pertinent features, subsequently employing a neural network encoder to differentiate between UAV signals and controller signals, as well as distinguishing among various UAV and controller models. The proposed model adopts an autoencoder architecture and introduces innovative enhancements in two key frameworks. The initial framework integrates skip connections within residual layers, thereby ensuring the preservation of essential information during convolutional operations. Simultaneously, the second framework harnesses this retained information to extract supplementary features, thereby enhancing the capability of the model to discern intricate patterns within the data. This amalgamation of the two key frameworks in the proposed model facilitates a more profound comprehension of the embedded feature information, and thereby enhances the efficiency of the system. The proposed model has achieved remarkable results in the experiments of UAV signal classification task, indicating that the optimization of neural network structure in this model is effective for RF signal processing.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Decision Method for Close Air Combat Maneuver Based on Hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the present work, a real-time maneuver decision method for close air combat based on hybrid particle swarm optimization (PSO) was proposed. Firstly, an air combat maneuver model was constructed to obtain the optimal situation, with the situation model that considers the missile launching zone offering the real-time maneuver decision basis. Subsequently, the hybrid PSO algorithm was employed to calculate the optimal control variables in maneuver decisions. The simulation results show that the hybrid PSO algorithm can calculate the optimal control variables in maneuver decisions more quickly and effectively, providing a reliable reference for pilots to make maneuver decisions.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Leaf Disease Recognition Model for MobileNetV2 Based on Transfer Learning and Knowledge Distillation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Accurate identification of plant diseases is critical for the sustainability and efficiency of agricultural production. Traditional image recognition models have limitations in fine-grained disease feature extraction, which may affect the accuracy and usefulness of recognition. To address this issue, this paper presents a MobileNetV2 model optimized by knowledge distillation techniques that significantly improves plant disease recognition on mobile devices. By using a lightweight but efficient student model and combining it with a transfer learning technique, we successfully approach the performance of the complex teacher model DenseNet201, achieving high accuracy and utility of the model. The model is particularly suitable for resource-constrained devices such as mobile and embedded systems.

articleTitle: Application of Autonomous Control for Quadruped Robots Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To endow the simulated quadruped robot with autonomous action control capabilities, this paper proposes the use of the PPO (Proximal Policy Optimization) algorithm, a deep reinforcement learning technique, to enable the quadruped robot to make autonomous decisions during walking tasks. Since walking tasks involve continuous actions that depend not only on the current state but also on past actions and states, this paper improves the PPO algorithm with LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory) to enhance the autonomous decision-making ability of the quadruped robot during walking. Using PyBullet to simulate the walking environment of the quadruped robot, experiments have verified that the improved PPO algorithm significantly outperforms the unimproved PPO algorithm in terms of performance.

articleTitle: Application of ResUNet-CBAM in Rock Sheet Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This study is dedicated to solving the problems of low accuracy and high cost of traditional methods in the image segmentation of reservoir rock flakes. By fusing the convolutional neural network ResNet-50 with the encoder of UNet, the original space suitable for rock sheet images is constructed. In addition, the attention mechanism CBAM module is introduced to compensate for the loss of accuracy due to parameter optimization. The proposed model fusing the attention mechanism and the residual network shows better performance and accuracy in the rock sheet image segmentation task. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the method is improved by 3.66 percentage points compared with the base model, which brings new breakthroughs and progress in the field of reservoir rock sheet image segmentation.

articleTitle: Simulation Research on the Natural Gas Flow Sensor Based the MEMS Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Due to its unique advantages, the MEMS technology exhibits obvious interdisciplinary characteristics, and is crossly applied with the sensor technology that yields the MEMS sensor technology. The emerging MEMS sensor technology then gained many unique advantages, such as small volume, light weight, high precision, and high integration etc. In this paper, the temperature field distribution and the flow field distribution of the thermal gas flow sensor based on the MEMS technology are simulated and discussed. The simulation results show that the temperature near the area of the heating resistor is the highest when there is no gas flow, and that the temperature field is symmetrically distributed along the x-axis. However, when the gas flows passing through, the symmetry of the temperature field is destroyed, and the farther away from the heating resistor, the more seriously the symmetry is destroyed. At the same time, the greater the vertical height above from the surface of the heating resistor, the more serious the asymmetry of the temperature field. In the y-direction, the fluid velocity distribution in the area that far away from the surface of the heating resistor is very uniform and basically with no fluctuation. However, in the area that near the surface of the heating resistor, the velocity field distribution fluctuates greatly, especially at the corners of the edges of the resistors. The main reason is the local influence caused by the geometric structure of the resistor.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Multi-Timescale and Spatial Convolutional Skillful Cross-Stacking Model for Assisted Brain-Computer Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In recent years, deep learning models have received attention for EEG classification tasks due to their excellent performance and ability to extract complex features from raw data. With regard to brain-computer interfaces (BCI) that depend on a variety of control signals, such as motor imagery (MI) and event-related potentials (ERP), convolutional neural networks (CNN) in particular have show promise. In this study, we propose a new CNN, called EEG-Inception-CBAM, which improves the accuracy of ERP-based assisted brain-computer interfaces. To the best of our knowledge, EEG-Inception-CBAM is the first model that integrates the improved Inception module for ERP and MI detection, and it is efficiently combined with other structures in the lightweight architecture to improve the performance of our approach. The model was validated on the TRP dataset of 73 subjects (42 controls, 31 with severe disabilities) and the BCI Competition IV 2a dataset The validation results show that compared to DeepConvNet and EEG-Net, the command decoding accuracy of EEG-Inception-CBAM improves on both datasets by 7.13%, 5.2%, 4.02%, and 2.36%, respectively. It outperforms the previous 2 methods. To further improve the method's practicability for use in assistive applications, EEG-Inception-CBAM employs a novel training process that combines fine-tuning with cross-disciplinary transfer learning. This means that the system only needs a few number of calibration attempts to get ultra-high performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Normalized Different Wetness Index (NDWI) Using Landsat Imagery for Confluent Area of Multi Water Resources in Western Jinan
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To properly assess the advantages of water system connection projects, protect the environment, and manage all available water resources in the confluence area, it is crucial to investigate the spatial and temporal characteristics of the water resources after the formation of the confluent area of multi water resources in Western Jinan. Based on the Landsat image series, this paper decoded the Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) for the intersection area. The spatial and temporal variation characteristics and trends of NDWI were calculated and analyzed using the Theil-Sen median and McDonald-Kreitman test. The results showed that the interannual variability of NDWI in the study area was small, with large fluctuations in spring and autumn. The Yuqing Lake reservoir, sand settling pond, and wetland water body were the high-value area of NDWI, while the low-value area was distributed in the farmland along the Yellow River Basin. In terms of variation trend, NDWI in the precipitation period showed a fluctuating upward trend. The area of significant increase and extremely significant increase accounted for 10.44% and 7.32%, respectively, and were mainly situated in some lakes, the mainstream of the Yellow River, and the sand-settling pond in the park.

articleTitle: Cloud-Edge-End Collaboration for Intelligent Management in Offshore Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to offshore wind farm management by introducing a cloud-edge-end collaborative framework enhanced with Internet of Things (IoT) technology. We detail the development of an intelligent management platform specifically tailored for offshore wind farms, leveraging Alibaba Cloud infrastructure. Through this platform, visual analysis and reporting capabilities are implemented to facilitate informed decision-making. Additionally, a wind power curve prediction model is seamlessly integrated into the system to further enhance operational efficiency and performance. This integrated framework represents a significant advancement in the management and optimization of offshore wind energy systems, offering promising prospects for the future of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Optimizing Edge Computing for Telemedicine: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach to Task Offloading and Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This study introduces an optimized Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) framework specifically designed for telemedicine applications. By integrating deep reinforcement learning (DRL), we develop a system that enhances task offloading and resource management in edge computing environments. Our approach focuses on the critical needs of healthcare monitoring, such as urgency in emergency responses and sustainability in power usage. The proposed model employs a parallel processing architecture that minimizes energy consumption and processing time by intelligently managing data flow and computational tasks across multiple edge servers. Key innovations include the use of a Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) algorithm, which dynamically optimizes the balance between processing speed and energy efficiency, ensuring robust and timely medical services. Through extensive simulations, our model demonstrates significant improvements in cost-effectiveness and operational efficiency compared to traditional methods, making it a promising solution for future smart healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Research on Charging Station Site Selection Based on Immune Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the large-scale development of electric vehicles, in response to the challenges faced by charging stations, scattered power sources, and insufficient maintenance capabilities, the first step is to analyze multiple sources of data. In response to the shortcomings of the algorithm, an improved immune particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed with the goal of minimizing the distance between users and charging stations, achieving adaptive search within the region. Finally, the effectiveness and rationality of the model were verified through simulation experiments, providing decision-making references for the scientific site selection of charging stations.

articleTitle: Efficient Image Super-Resolution using Large Kernel Convolution Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Super-resolution techniques serve as a cornerstone in the realm of image processing, offering a pathway to elevate the resolution and fidelity of images, thus opening up a myriad of possibilities across various domains within computer vision. In our paper, we introduce an innovative approach aimed at striking a delicate balance between parameter efficiency and performance in the realm of SR tasks. Our method capitalizes on the potent capabilities of the Large Convolution Kernel Attention Mechanism, a novel framework that enables us to achieve remarkable results by harnessing the power of attention mechanisms alongside large convolutional kernels. At the heart of our proposed methodology lies a profound innovation: the seamless integration of attention mechanisms into the SR framework, with a specialized focus on leveraging large convolutional kernels. This strategic fusion allows our model to operate with unparalleled efficiency, dynamically spotlighting crucial features within the image while concurrently dampening the influence of extraneous or less relevant information. This selective attention mechanism proves to be instrumental in driving substantial enhancements in the quality of reconstructed images, effectively refining the fine details and overall perceptual fidelity. The method proposed in this study achieves a balance between the amount of parameters and calculations and super-resolution performance.

articleTitle: Modeling of Information Interaction Model for High-Speed Railway System Architecture: Taking Intelligent Dispatching Tasks as an Example
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, we utilize information flow to describe the process of information transmission and the characteristics of activities within the intelligent high-speed rail system, taking the high-speed rail dispatching task as an example, which is based on the existing achievements of the intelligent high-speed rail system architecture. Additionally, we establish the mapping relationships for high-speed railway dispatching activities and nodes, and develop a model for information interaction in high-speed railway dispatching. These results offer more practical and intuitive new methods and tools that enhance the content of the intelligent high-speed rail system architecture.

articleTitle: Research on New Encryption Technology Based on SM3 Message Digest
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the context of the digital age, the importance of information security is increasingly prominent, especially when facing complex network attack methods. SM3, as a password hashing algorithm recommended by the National Cryptography Administration of China, has high security and reliability in applications such as data integrity verification and digital signatures. However, the SM3 algorithm faces challenges of insufficient flexibility and slow encryption speed in practical applications. To address these issues, this study proposes an improved SM3 encryption algorithm. This algorithm enhances the randomness and unpredictability of the algorithm by introducing chaotic mapping and random numbers, effectively improving security. At the same time, the core steps of the algorithm - input expansion and message compression - have been optimized, significantly improving computational efficiency. The experimental results show that the new algorithm achieves a significant improvement in encryption efficiency while maintaining security, providing a new solution for large-scale encryption applications.

articleTitle: Defense Method of Image Reconstruction Based on Defense-DS
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the interference of deep neural network (DNN)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> by small adversarial attacks, which leads to a series of adversarial risks, this paper proposes a DefenseDS defense model, which combines discrete cosine transform (DCT) with depth convolution model based on Defense-GAN, and adds SE attention mechanism to remove adversarial interference in contaminated images. experiments show that this method is more effective. It can defend against different attack techniques in a short time.

articleTitle: USRP X410-Based Wireless Channel Measurement System and Path Loss Model Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Wireless channel measurement is crucial in various scenarios and frequencies, especially with the popularization of the Fifth Generation (5G) wireless communication technologies. The path loss is crucial for accurately characterizing the propagation properties of wireless channels. In this paper, the time-domain measurement equipment USRP X410 is used to measure and model the path loss. Compared to traditional measurement equipment, the USRP platform is more portable and cheaper, which can reduce the cost of channel measurement. In the context of path loss modeling, the Dragonfly Algorithm is utilized for optimization. The algorithm has varying degrees of optimization in different scenarios, and it has a significant optimization effect in the complex indoor NLOS environment.

articleTitle: RGB-T Salient Object Detection Based on the Segment Anything Model
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Salient object detection mimics the human visual system, segmenting targets using RGB and thermal infrared images suitable for low-light and occlusion scenarios. This technology faces challenges such as mismatched image resolutions and high equipment costs. This paper introduces an RGB-T salient object detection algorithm based on the “Segment Anything Model” (SAM), which enhances detection performance through modules like “High-Resolution Transformer Pixel Extraction” (HRTP), “Multiple Amplification Fusion” (MAF), “Noise Reduction Fusion Module” (NRF), and “Entropy-Based Pixel-Level Weighting Module” (EBPW). Experimental results show that this algorithm performs excellently on major datasets, accurately detecting salient objects and demonstrating potential for practical applications.

articleTitle: EREH-Net: A CNN and Transformer Hybrid Model for Industrial Robot Grasping Vision Localization
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Industrial robot vision localization system, aims to enable the vision system to identify the grasping center and rotation angle of target components, thereby assisting in the localization of industrial robot. However, there are limitations in identifying boundaries with weak contrast, and it is difficult to cover different products by the same algorithm. To address these challenges, this study proposes a hybrid network based on CNN and Transformer Salient Object Detection (SOD), as well as related grasping localization algorithm: First, our proposed hybrid network effectively utilizes both global and local features to segment targets. Then, the localization post-processing algorithm calculates the grasping center and rotation angle based on the contours of the segmentation image. Next, we introduce an Edge Reverse Enhance Module (EREM) to enhance the features of the segmentation boundary. Finally, Loss function is employed to measure the deviation between the segmentation boundary and ground truth, the center distance between prediction and ground truth. At the grasping center x, grasping center y, and rotation angle A, the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) reached 2.78 pixels, 5.75 pixels, and 2.43°, respectively, which were reduced by 45%, 38.2%, and 70.3% compared to the second place. The mIoU reaches 0.987, which is a 0.003 improvement over the second place. Furthermore, our model has been validated on other industrial datasets T-LESS.

articleTitle: Research on New Energy Generation Power Prediction Method Based on SSA-ELM
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Wind power generation forecasting plays a crucial role in enhancing the operational efficiency and reliability of wind power systems. This study proposes a wind power generation forecasting method that optimizes the Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) using the Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA). Firstly, actual wind power data is collected and preprocessed. Next, the SSA is utilized to optimize the ELM, aiming to enhance the accuracy and generalization ability of the prediction model. Subsequently, the processed data is fed into the prediction model for training and forecasting. Finally, simulation results demonstrate that the ELM model optimized by the SSA exhibits higher accuracy and stability in wind power generation forecasting compared to traditional methods. Thus, this approach provides an effective optimization solution for wind power generation forecasting, potentially improving the operational efficiency and reliability of wind power systems.

articleTitle: Research on the 3D Deployment of Heterogeneous User UAV Base Stations Based on Voronoi Diagram Division
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming to maximize the channel capacity for users with different communication demands, this paper proposes a Voronoi diagram-based heterogeneous user communication coverage algorithm (VCCU). Initially, the maximum coverage radius of the UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) base station is determined, and the operational area is divided accordingly. Subsequently, the position of the UAV base station is preliminarily determined based on the distribution and communication requirements of the users. Finally, the VCCU algorithm is employed for regional division, adjusting the coverage radius and deployment altitude of the UAV base station in conjunction with the user distribution, and discussing the affiliation of boundary users. Ultimately, the 3D deployment position of the UAV base station is ascertained, leading to the optimization of system performance. Simulation results demonstrate that the algorithm can effectively enhance user channel capacity and reduce average path loss.

articleTitle: Short-Term Wind Power Prediction Using Mutual Information and Two-Layer Long Short-Term Memory Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To better capture the nonlinear and high-dimensional characteristics of complex time-series data in wind power data and increase the accuracy of wind power prediction, a short-term wind power prediction model that integrates mutual information and two-layer LSTM is offered. The model screens feature with high correlation from wind power historical data by using an mutual information algorithm based on Kernel Density Estimation and performing wind power prediction based on two-layer LSTM. The performance of the model is tested by a real wind farm dataset, and the proposed model performs well in terms of generalization ability and accuracy compared with the single-layer LSTM and the traditional BP neural network model and verifies the effectiveness and advantages of this model in the field of short-term wind power prediction.

articleTitle: Improved Vehicle Pedestrian Recognition Algorithm for YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To address the challenge of detecting small targets at a distance in complex traffic scenes, this study focuses on targets located at varying distances from the lens. The algorithm has been improved by replacing the C-IOU loss with a new Alpha-IOU loss, which enhances the detector's flexibility and robustness for vehicle detection. Additionally, a smaller P2 detection layer has been added to detect relatively small targets at long distances. The algorithm has also been modified to include four-scale detection, which improves its ability to learn the features of small targets. Experimental results show that the improved algorithm achieves 93.5% detection accuracy on the homemade vehicle-pedestrian dataset BDD-P, which is 1.4 percentage points higher than the original algorithm, and 76 FPS detection speed, showing good detection precision and responsiveness.

articleTitle: Borehole Trajectory System Based on Microservices Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This research aims to integrate microservices architecture into the borehole trajectory design system, addressing the challenges faced by traditional monolithic systems in processing big data and rapid updates.
