By dividing and deploying the frontend, backend, database, database operation modules, and the drilling trajectory module as microservices, this paper achieves coordinated operation among system components through a loosely coupled architecture, thereby efficiently completing system functions. This method not only improves adaptability to new technologies but also provides an effective strategy for overcoming existing problems.

articleTitle: Improving the Application of YOLOv8 in Image Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: As deep learning develops, the use of object detection to analyze image content has achieved stage-by-stage success. However, due to the problems of spatial occlusion and slow convergence, the accuracy is poor and models are complex. To address the above problems, a new YOLOv8s network structure that improves the accuracy with almost no increase in training overhead is proposed. First, the hierarchical feature extraction is utilized to enhance the positional information of the feature map by adding Coordinate Attention at backbone and neck networks layer-by-layer. Then, GCNet is introduced at the last layer of neck network to model global context and merge hierarchical features. Finally, SIOU Loss is used to accelerate the convergence speed to further improve the accuracy. The experimental results demonstrate that the enhanced model improves mAP by +4.6% over YOLOv8s and accuracy by +2.7% over YOLOv9s. Additionally, it slightly decreases model complexity and training overhead by 0.2 GFLOPs.

articleTitle: Analysis of Multistatic Sonobuoy Array Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the influence of three typical array layouts, namely triangular, square, and circular arrays, on the detection area of a multistatic sonobuoy detection system by employing track-initiation probability as the target detection probability. Simulation results indicate that circular arrays exhibit a larger detection area and superior performance. Additionally, selecting appropriate array spacing such as 2.5R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> during deployment contributes to enhancing sonar performance. Moreover, the study reveals the presence of a scale effect in multistatic systems. In practical applications, considering the maneuverable and flexible construction of the multistatic sonobuoy detection system, the findings of this study can provide theoretical references for the design of sonobuoy layouts in anti-submarine warfare, thereby improving the detection performance of sonobuoys.

articleTitle: Operator Action Recognition Based on Improved ST-GCN
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the electric power industry, the safety problems of the personnel working with electricity are becoming more and more prominent. Traditional solutions relying on manual methods perform poorly in ensuring safety and are in urgent need of updating and improvement. In recent years, the application of computer vision technology has provided new possibilities for improving safety standards, especially the important role of human skeletal dynamics in action recognition is becoming more and more prominent. In order to effectively solve the existing safety challenges of power-carrying operations, this paper proposes a power-carrying operation action recognition method based on ST-GCN (Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks). The method combines a pose estimation algorithm and an action recognition algorithm to achieve the purpose of action recognition, in which the improved OpenPose algorithm is used for pose estimation to obtain the skeletal data, and then the ST-GCN is used for action recognition, in which a channel attention module CBAM (Convolutional Block Attention Module) is added for enhancement of action features. After experiments, it is confirmed that the spatio-temporal graph convolutional network method proposed in this paper shows excellent results in practical applications and effectively improves the safety and security level of the personnel working with electricity.

articleTitle: Design of 200W Double Biased GaN Power Amplifier Based on X Parameter
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The paper proposes a circuit design simulation method based on X-parameters. To address the challenge of conducting harmonic simulations in ADS for self-developed devices lacking models. This paper integrates a Load Pull experimental platform to establish an X-parameter extraction system. X-parameters can be encapsulated as a “black box” model and imported into ADS for RF signal simulation. This provides designers with a new solution for precisely optimizing parameters and greatly reduces the difficulty of later testing and debugging tasks. Base on X-parameters, the paper designs a high-power and high-efficiency dual-bias gallium nitride power amplifier. The final physical test data shows that at a center operating frequency of 2.1 GHz, the gain is 19.9 dB, drain efficiency is 71%, and saturation power is 53 dBm (200W). The test results are largely consistent with the simulation results using X-parameter models, confirming the accuracy and feasibility of the model. This design method exhibits significant engineering practicality.

articleTitle: Hybrid Recommendation Algorithm Based on K-Means++ and Dynamic Time Weights
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A hybrid recommendation algorithm based on K-means++ and dynamic temporal weights is proposed to address the problems of data sparsity and low temporal correlation in traditional collaborative filtering recommendation algorithms. The Weight Slope One algorithm fills the score matrix and reduces the data sparsity, then the K-means++ clustering algorithm is used to cluster the filled data, and then the dynamic time weight is introduced into the collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on the user and the item and the item and user dependence is adjusted by the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\beta}$</tex> adjusting factor, to achieve better stability and accuracy. Experimental results show that the algorithm better solves the problems of sparse rating data, poor recommendation timeliness, and significantly improved recommendation effect.

articleTitle: Application of Elman-AdaBoost Neural Network in Predicting Aeroengine Flight Thrust
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: As we all know flight thrust is one of the most important performance parameters of aeroengines. However, flight thrust is difficult to measure. To predict aircraft engine flight thrust, this research analyzes a large amount of aeroengine high-altitude bench test data and flight test data, using Elman-AdaBoost neural network to establish a prediction model of aero-engine flight thrust. And thrust prediction model was applied during engine flight tests and achieved good results. The research results show that the aeroengine flight thrust prediction method based on the Elman-AdaBoost Algorithms can predict the engine flight thrust within the full flight envelope. Compared with the flight thrust results calculated by the gas generator method, the mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) is 2.68%. Furthermore, the performance of the Elman-AdaBoost neural network based thrust prediction model was compared with that of traditional thrust prediction model based on Elman neural network &BP neural network& least square support vector machine (LSSVM). The validation results show that the Elman-AdaBoost based thrust prediction model proposed in this research has excellent thrust prediction performance.

articleTitle: AttBoT-YOLO: Beyond Efficient YOLOv5 for PCB Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a lightweight defect detection algorithm called AttBoT-YOLO, aiming to solve the issues of missed detection, high false detection rate, and difficulty in identifying various types of defects in most current printed circuit board (PCB) defect detection methods. Firstly, the backbone of the network is adjusted based on the Bottleneck Transformer to enhance the feature extraction and generalization capabilities of the network. Secondly, a coordinate attention mechanism is integrated to provide better feature correlation for the model, further improving the detection accuracy. Experimental results show that the improved YOLOv5 model achieves an average precision (mAP) of 96.4% on the PCB defect dataset, which is 1.4% higher than the baseline, and achieves an accuracy of 96.1%, enabling more accurate detection of defects in industrial production of printed circuit boards.

articleTitle: ECG Signal Classification Based on Attention Mechanism and 1D-CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is a prevalent clinical arrhythmia, posing a significant health risk. Efficient diagnosis relies on ECG signals. To enhance timely and accurate AF diagnosis, we propose a method that integrates attention mechanism and convolutional neural network (CNN) for ECG signal classification. Firstly, we improve signal-to-noise ratio via discrete wavelet transform. Next, we extract features using 1dCNN. Finally, the attention mechanism assigns different weights to extract important information, enhancing classification performance and generalization. Extensive comparative and ablation experiments validate our method's effectiveness, achieving 99.60% accuracy and 99.61% F1-Score on the test set. This approach offers a superior tool for ECG signal classification and diagnosis.

articleTitle: Construction of Digital Evaluation Model for Distribution Network Business Based on GIM 3D Design Results
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Due to the diversity of the original distribution network business data composition, the process of promoting the digitalization of its review process is faced with the problem that its reliability is difficult to be guaranteed. Therefore, a study on the construction of the digital review model of distribution network business based on the GIM 3D design results is proposed. After unifying the format of data related to distribution network business (including but not limited to equipment information, line information, topology structure, operation parameters, etc.) of different sources and quality with GIM 3D design tools, use the GIM parsing function to extract and analyze the distribution network business data, Conduct integrated analysis on the parameters of each dimension of the distribution network business data to determine the final review results. In the test results, not only is the Kappa value always stable above 0.85, but it is basical-ly unaffected by the scale of test business data. When the scale of test business data reaches 5.0% and increases to 25.0%, the corresponding Kappa value fluctuation range is only 0.03, with high reliability.

articleTitle: Research on Text Detection in Tourist Traffic Signs Based on an Improved DBNet
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To enhance the accuracy of text detection in tourism traffic signs, the simAM non-parametric attention mechanism is integrated during the downsampling stage of feature extraction in the DBNet network. This integration aims to suppress interference from non-text regions on tourism traffic signs, thereby increasing the focus on text areas without significantly adding to the parameter count. To address issues such as inconsistent character spacing and large variations in text area scale on tourism traffic signs, which lead to erroneous text segmentation and false detections, an ASPP module is incorporated within the feature pyramid structure. This addition enhances the model's ability to capture multi-scale contextual information and adapt to different text layouts. Experiments demonstrate that the improvements in the model have resulted in an increase of 3.2% in accuracy and 3.8% in recall rate.

articleTitle: Cross-Modal Domain Adaptation in Brain Disease Diagnosis: Maximum Mean Discrepancy-Based Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Brain disorders are a major challenge to global health, causing millions of deaths each year. Accurate diagnosis of these diseases relies heavily on advanced medical imaging techniques such as Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) and Computed Tomography (CT). However, the scarcity of annotated data poses a significant challenge in deploying machine learning models for medical diagnosis. To address this limitation, deep learning techniques have shown considerable promise. Domain adaptation techniques enhance a model's ability to generalize across imaging modalities by transferring knowledge from one domain (e.g., CT images) to another (e.g., MRI images). Such cross-modality adaptation is essential to improve the ability of models to consistently generalize across different imaging modalities. This study collected relevant resources from the Kaggle website and employed the Maximum Mean Difference (MMD) method - a popular domain adaptation method - to reduce the differences between imaging domains. By combining MMD with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), the accuracy and utility of the model is obviously enhanced. The excellent experimental results highlight the great potential of data-driven domain adaptation techniques to improve diagnostic accuracy and efficiency, especially in resource-limited environments. By bridging the gap between different imaging modalities, the study aims to provide clinicians with more reliable diagnostic tools.

articleTitle: Research on 5G-R Handover Algorithm with Improved Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A 5G-R handover algorithm with improved fuzzy logic is proposed to address the issues of fixed traditional algorithm parameters for high-speed railway in future 5G-R communication scenarios. Firstly, a wireless signal propagation model for 5G-R was established in open scenes such as suburban areas; Secondly, parameters such as railway speed, Received Signal Reference Power, and Signal to Interference plus Noise Ratio were selected, and fuzzy processing was performed on them using trapezoidal and triangular membership functions as input values for the fuzzy inference system; Once again, a hierarchical fuzzy reasoning system was designed, which reduces the number of fuzzy rules through hierarchical reasoning and outputs the adjusted hysteresis threshold value after deblurring; Finally, the simulation results show that compared with similar algorithms, the proposed algorithm has lower handover delay and effectively improves the stability of high-speed railway handover.

articleTitle: Research on PV Power Prediction Method Based on LDBO-BP
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The traditional neural network method has some defects in the prediction process and still needs further optimisation and enhancement. Therefore, in this paper, a Logistic Chaos Mapping improved Dung Beetle Optimization (DBO) algorithm is proposed to optimise the photovoltaic (PV) power prediction model for Back Propagation (BP) neural networks. Experimental results on the Sanyo dataset show that the LDBO-BP method is an effective PV power prediction method.

articleTitle: Computer Vision-Based Mobile Sorting System System Construction and Experimental Test
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The mobile sorting system holds significant importance in terms of enhancing logistics efficiency and reducing labor costs. This paper designed a movable sorting system built based on the combination of embedded microcontrollers and computer vision. The entire system includes key components such as the STM32F103RCT6 microcontroller, Mecanum wheels, four-degree-of-freedom mechanical parts, and the Openart mini camera module. The system control is divided into three parts: firstly, Mecanum wheels omnidirectional movement is achieved through kinematic inverse solution, then precise attitude control of the system is realized by using cascaded and parallel PID combined with feedback from gyro sensors and encoders. The visual part of the system first corrects the distortion of the captured images, and then performs image classification recognition based on the MobileNet V2 model. According to experimental results, recognition accuracy of over 97% has been achieved. In future item sorting, this technology will greatly reduce labor costs and improve sorting efficiency.

articleTitle: Athlete Performance Analysis: Machine Learning for Predicting Tennis Player Scores
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In recent years, machine learning and deep learning have become increasingly prevalent in the field of data classification and regression, with applications in a diverse range of disciplines. Furthermore, the field of sports analytics is also gradually becoming one of the topics of machine learning research. The application of machine learning and deep learning technologies to the analysis of real-time data from sporting events enables a more accurate understanding of the performance and status of athletes. Coaches can then combine these results to determine the current state of the athlete, which allows them to adjust the game strategy accordingly and increase the probability of winning. This study employs the example of tennis, utilising detailed data from the game “The Championships Wimbledon 2023”. The data was subjected to preliminary processing in order to identify the key factors that influence the players' scores. The data was then subjected to regression and prediction using a variety of machine learning algorithms and multilayer perceptron machines in deep learning. The results demonstrate that LightGBM and NLP are the most effective algorithms for accurately evaluating the current state of athletes with the available data.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Surface Reconstruction Techniques: Traditional Approaches vs GeoUDF Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the continuous progress of computer vision and graphics technology, surface reconstruction has become a key research direction in this field. This study provides a comprehensive and in-depth analysis of three traditional methods in surface reconstruction: Alpha shape, Ball pivoting algorithm and Poisson method, as well as the newly emerging GeoUDF method. Through comparative experiments, this paper selects a unified data set to verify these four methods. The experimental results reveal that Alpha shape, Ball pivoting algorithm and GeoUDF perform relatively well in the accuracy of surface reconstruction, while the Poisson method lags behind. It is particularly worth noting that the loss function of GeoUDF method in the training process shows a significant downward trend with the increase of training times, and the loss is generally small, which further confirms its accuracy in dealing with surface reconstruction tasks. Finally, the applicability and potential problems of the four surface reconstruction methods are discussed, and the future technical progress and direction in the field of surface reconstruction are prospected. This study not only provides a powerful reference for the application and development of surface reconstruction technology, but also provides valuable experimental data and insights for related researchers.

articleTitle: Multi-Source Heterogeneous Data Cell Information Processing Model
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Current data organization methods are difficult to effectively integrate and conduct association analysis on massive multi-source heterogeneous data. To address this issue, this paper introduces a Data Cell Information Processing Model (DCIPM), which considers data cells as the basic units. Entities and transactions are extracted from various multi-source heterogeneous databases and encapsulated with algorithms. By designing multi-level data cells, logical relationships between entities and transactions are constructed to form a comprehensive data cell network. According to the given task requirements, various types of data across different industries are collected and analyzed following specific logical rules without impacting the data structures of databases, and then the desired results are returned. This presents a novel approach for efficiently organizing various types of dispersed heterogeneous data.

articleTitle: Seismic Signal Classification Research Based on Multi-Attention Mechanism Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The accurate identification of seismic signals is of great significance for cleaning earthquake catalogs and earthquake early warning. Traditional identification methods require extracting features from the time domain waveform signals as inputs for classification algorithms. This paper proposes a novel method for seismic signals classification based on multi-attention mechanism residual network, which directly utilizes the waveform signals that have undergone simple processing as the inputs for the network. The network model uses deep residual neural network as its fundamental structure and integrates channel attention mechanism and spatial attention mechanism, which optimizes the network's attention to critical information within seismic waveform signals. Furthermore, global average importance pooling is applied in the network to broaden the pooling field and acquire more feature information. We select 94 natural earthquake events and 98 artificial explosion events occurred from 2010 to 2016 near the national capital region of China such as Shunyi district in Beijing and Sanhe city in Hebei, with a magnitude ranging from 1.5 to 2.8, as the research subjects. We use the five-fold cross validation method for classification. The experimental results demonstrate that the method achieves exceptionally high accuracy in distinguishing between natural earthquake events and artificial explosion events, with the highest accuracy of 98.83% and the average accuracy of 98.53%. Compared with the traditional Support Vector Machine (SVM) method, ResNet18 and Deep Residual SPP Non-local Efficient Shrinkage Network (RSNN), ours demonstrates superior classification performance.

articleTitle: Research on Data Mining Technology of Internet Privacy Protection Based on Local Differential Privacy
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of social economy and science and technology, data sharing and analysis technology is one of the contents widely used in the Internet field. Collecting and distributing terminal data and mining analysis is the normal form of big data analysis. Under the condition of mutual distrust between the collector and the terminal data owner, privacy protection in data collection and analysis will directly affect the application results of big data analysis. Nowadays, localized differential privacy has been applied in data acquisition and data mining analysis. Although there are still many problems in relevant theories and technologies, with the continuous in-depth research of scientific researchers, relevant issues have been proposed according to practical cases, which not only effectively control the privacy budget loss, but also improve the accuracy of data application. Therefore, on the basis of understanding the concept of localized differential privacy and related models, and according to the current application status of Internet privacy protection data mining technology, this paper proposes a clustering method with LDP GMMC as the core. The final experimental results show that the improved data acquisition method can better meet the privacy protection requirements in the non-spherically distributed data scenario.

articleTitle: Low Dynamic Brain Magnetic Resonance Image Enhancement Using Type-II Fuzzy Set
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain is a non-invasive medical imaging technique used to obtain detailed images of brain structures, and it is an indispensable tool in clinical practice. However, during the imaging process, low dynamic range MRI images may occur, with little variation between image brightness and contrast. This type of image may occur for various reasons and poses specific challenges. To address this issue, this paper proposes an improved algorithm based on Type-II fuzzy sets to enhance the contrast of grayscale images while preserving the brightness and details of the MRI images. The algorithm uses new upper and lower limits, a modified Hamacher t-conorm, and transformation-based gamma correction methods to provide enhanced images. Furthermore, the method offers good interpretability, which is crucial for improving diagnostic accuracy and transparency of the technique. The proposed method was compared with six recent contrast enhancement methods and showed good results on five evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Dual Band Flexible Transparent Microstrip Patch Antenna Based on Metal Mesh
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: As an important component of wireless communication systems, antennas not only need to have the ability to transmit and receive electromagnetic waves, but also need to have some new capabilities, such as conformal ability, transparency ability, and multi frequency characteristics. This article proposes a symmetrical inverted U-shaped slot rectangular microstrip patch antenna, which uses a flexible PDMS (polydimethylsiloxane) material as the substrate of the microstrip antenna, and a metal mesh as the radiation patch of the antenna, with a size of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{15}\mathbf{mm}\times \mathbf{15}\mathbf{mm}\times \mathbf{0.8}\mathbf{mm}$</tex>. Using HFSS simulation software, the results show that the antenna has achieved operating frequency bands of 9.70~10.06GHz and 13.33 ~ 13.47GHz, with a maximum gain of 4.95dB and a transparency of 81%. It has good unidirectional radiation performance and bending characteristics, which improves the transparency of the antenna and can be applied in various application scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Super-Low Frequency Cross-Media Communication for Underwater Robots Based on Mechanical Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Underwater robots are increasingly used in the ocean. However, under the lossy medium environment, the traditional underwater wireless communication system suffers from the defects of large transmission attenuation, weak penetration ability and high time delay. For this reason, this paper proposes a new method of super-low frequency (SLF, 30-300Hz) cross-media communication for underwater robots in lossy medium environments based on mechanical antenna, which generates SLF magnetic signals from mechanical antenna mounted on the robot, and receives the signals from sensors on the ground. The electromagnetic signals in the SLF band are utilized for communication, and the method has high propagation stability and anti-interference due to the characteristics of the SLF band. Detailed theoretical analysis and positioning experiments are carried out based on this method. The results show that the localization method proposed in this paper has strong feasibility and will provide a new method for underwater robot communication, which can be used in a variety of complex industrial environments in the future.

articleTitle: Optimization of Macro Placement Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This thesis presents a novel approach to macro-layout in physical design, combining genetic algorithms with traditional design techniques. Genetic algorithms simulate the process of genetic evolution by natural selection, whereby the most environmentally adapted individuals are obtained through the evolution of reproduction from generation to generation. In this paper, the macro layout is represented by individuals, and the characteristics of the macro layout are used to constrain it. In the algorithm presented in this paper, each individual's adaptation action to their environmental context is used to represent the line length. The smaller the line length, the greater the macro layout's conformity to its constraints. Finally, the physical design of different macro layouts is compared with the timing obtained by STA tool. The final conversion time violation of macro layout applying the algorithm of this paper achieved an average reduction of 6.8% in violation and 17% in the number of violation paths compared to manual macro layout. The macro layout has been optimized.

articleTitle: Roadside Lidar Object Detection Based on Improved Second
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the continuous progress of deep learning technology and the growing affordability of LiDAR, research on 3D object detection technology based on LiDAR has attracted much attention in the field of vehicle-infrastructure cooperation. Currently, deep learning algorithms for 3D object detection based on LiDAR are predominantly utilized in autonomous driving data collected by vehicle-mounted LiDAR. However, fewer studies were focused on deep learning-based object detection using roadside LiDAR data. This paper proposes a 3D object detection algorithm based on roadside LiDAR, named DE-SECOND, which is an adaptation of the well-established SECOND network. DE-SECOND employs enhanced dynamic voxel coding to overcome the limitations of conventional voxel coding, which often discards valuable information when the number of points and voxels exceeds the preset threshold. Additionally, in order to allow sparse convolution to more effectively ascertain the significance of various positions, focal sparse convolution layers are introduced into the DE-SECOND backbone network. Finally, to render the detection head more perceptive and attuned to the task, a dynamic detection head is proposed. DE-SECOND has undergone training and evaluation on the DAIR-V2X-I dataset. The empirical results indicate that DE-SECOND outperforms SECOND, boosting vehicle detection accuracy by an average of 2.77% and pedestrian detection accuracy by an average of 4.6%.

articleTitle: HEVC Intra Prediction Acceleration Algorithm Based on Image Texture
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Compared to H.264/AVC, the next-generation High Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC) achieves a 50% reduction in bit rate while maintaining equivalent video quality. However, this improvement comes at the cost of significantly increased computational complexity during encoding. As a result, there is an increasing demand for fast real-time coding algorithms for HEVC encoders. To address this issue and reduce coding complexity, it is crucial to investigate efficient algorithms for HEVC. In this paper, we propose a hardware implementation algorithm that focuses on coding unit (CU) partitioning and prediction mode selection. For CU size partitioning, we introduce an adaptive algorithm based on image texture complexity to effectively filter out unnecessary coding blocks. Additionally, we optimize the selection of intra prediction modes by reducing redundant candidates based on each Prediction Unit's texture direction. This approach helps minimize computational complexity during the coding process. The experimental results demonstrate that compared with HEVC test model HM16.20, the proposed algorithm can save an average of approximately 48.89% in coding time without compromising overall performance.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Image Steganalysis Based on Forensics Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The purpose of image steganalysis is to detect secret information embedded in digital images. Currently, deep learning-based image steganalysis methods have achieved good detection performance. However, existing deep learning-based steganalysis methods rarely consider image selection. And some networks only use fixed filter kernels, rarely exploiting the learning ability of the network. This leads to the mismatch problem of existing steganalysis models and poses great challenges to steganalysis. To solve the mismatch problem of hybrid heterogeneous image steganalysis, we propose a forensic-assisted image steganalysis scheme. First, a classifier is used to classify the image source and filter different types of image sets, and then different versions of the steganalysis analyser are trained for different types of image sets to process the corresponding classes of images. The Steganalyser is designed to perform its feature learning efficiently. In the experiments, we applied the most advanced steganalysis model and several datasets to validate the scheme and achieve better results. The feasibility of the scheme is verified.

articleTitle: Haptic Adjective Recognition Dataset Construction and Verification
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Researchers have been increasingly interested in understanding how humans describe the haptic sensation of objects, aiming to enhance the adaptability of robots in complex tasks. Adjective recognition aims to furnish robots with high-level attribute feature information about their environment. In existing adjective recognition research, the PHAC-2 Dataset has been commonly used for evaluating algorithms. In order to promote adjective recognition algorithm research, we create a new dataset to evaluate adjective properties, named the Haptic Adjective Recognition (HAR) Dataset. This dataset is generated from sliding experiments using a bionic fingertip equipped with force sensors and IMUs. In addition, we propose an adjective recognition method to evaluate the plausibility of the HAR Dataset. We conduct extensive experiments, and the experimental results demonstrate that: (i) our model is highly effective on seen materials, achieving classification accuracy of 98.68% and F1 score of 97.44<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>; (ii) our model exhibits certain generalization capability on unseen materials, though with some unsatisfactory test results on some specific materials. The results prove the reasonableness of the HAR Dataset distribution, while also underscore the potential of exploring algorithms with robust generalization capabilities for unseen materials. The complete HAR dataset is available for download on Google Drive.

articleTitle: Defect Apple Detection Method Based on Lightweight YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To address the challenges of slow detection speeds and high computational resource demands in multi-target apple defect detection, we propose a lightweight method using YOLOv8. This method involves substituting the YOLOv8 backbone with MobileOneNet to reduce network complexity. Additionally, GSConv replaces standard convolution in the YOLOv8 neck structure, enhancing the detector's performance. To counteract the accuracy loss from this streamlining, WIoU is introduced in place of CIoU as the regression loss function, thereby improving model accuracy. Experiments on a defective apple dataset revealed that our modified method achieves a mean Average Precision (mAP) of 91.1%, a 0.4% increase over the original YOLOv8. Moreover, our approach reduces model size by 39.5% and increases frame rate from 72.68 to 82.72 frames per second.

articleTitle: BOAformer: Object Detection Network Based on Background-Object Attention Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: At present, deep learning has achieved great success in the field of object detection. To ensure that positive samples in the image are not missed, most deep-learning object detection methods set many prediction boxes and use the same prediction operation on them. Although these methods can obtain higher predictive values for high certainty objects, they may identify objects with lower certainty, such as small or fuzzy objects, as negative samples or miss them. To address this issue, this paper presents an object detection network based on background-object attention transformer (BOAformer), which improves the accuracy of object detection by establishing the relationship between background and object features. Firstly, the existing classification model is employed to obtain scores of object prediction boxes. On this basis, a scoring mechanism is designed to filter out high scoring object prediction boxes to reduce the computational complexity of the later network. Then, to improve the accuracy of object detection, BOAformer is constructed, which obtains auxiliary classification values of objects by learning the relationship between background and object features, and adds them to the initial detection results. Finally, many experiments are conducted to verify the effectiveness of BOAformer. The experimental results show that the designed network improves the accuracy of object detection and can detect small or lost objects in the background.

articleTitle: Hardware Design of Single-Precision Floating-Point Number Squaring Circuit Based on Modified Non-Restoring Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The role of floating-point square root operations in scientific computing is important in numerous application areas. Its efficiency and accuracy directly impact system performance and result accuracy. However, the traditional floating-point square root algorithm has certain limitations in terms of speed and accuracy. This paper presents the hardware circuit structure of the improved Non-Restoring algorithm, implemented using a timing circuit. A Xilinx XC7A15T-2CPG236I FPGA was used for the simulation and performance evaluation of the hardware circuit implementation of the proposed algorithm. The results demonstrated that the hardware circuit required 149 storage units (LUTs), consumed 0.0028 W, and operated at a maximum frequency of 279 MHz. The hardware circuit proposed in this paper has 93.5% fewer LUTs, 97.6% lower power consumption, and 135.06 MHz higher frequency than the traditional hardware circuit. This reduction in power consumption is achieved without any loss of computational accuracy, as the frequency is increased. This new solution for floating-point square root arithmetic offers a significant improvement in both speed and hardware resource consumption.

articleTitle: Multi-Stage Progressive Generative Adversarial Network for Low-Dose CT Denoising
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To address the balance between spatial details and high-level contextual information in low-dose CT image denoising tasks, a multi-stage progressive generative adversarial network is introduced. This network learns features from CT images in three phases, transitioning from coarse to fine. Wavelet transforms are employed in the initial two phases to expand the perceptual domain of the image. Subsequently, a dense residual network enhances the expression of image details in the third phase. This integration of information across stages facilitates the capture of multi-scale information and abstract features. Additionally, a discriminator equipped with multi-scale re-sidual modules is designed to improve noise artifact discrimination. Experimental results demonstrate significant outperformance of our proposed network over existing algorithms in denoising performance, both quantitatively and qualitatively.

articleTitle: Rec-DOGA: Recommendation-Enabled Dynamic Online Gradient Ascent Cache Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Caching integrated with recommendation systems has emerged as a prominent trend in the caching research field, particularly concerning the volume of data within the network and diverse user requirements. We cast the caching problem in dynamic network environments and propose a new approach validated in dynamic network environments that combines recommendation systems with caching strategies: a Recommendation-Enabled Dynamic Online Gradient Ascent Cache Algorithm (Rec-DOGA). We first construct an online gradient ascent cache model with the recommendation mechanism to minimize dynamic regret in the recommendation process. Furthermore, we provide theoretical proof for the stability of this strategy when combining recommendation systems and caching while maintaining sublinear dynamic regret. This demonstrates its potential to achieve optimal performance in dynamic environments. Finally, our approach demonstrates outstanding performance in dynamic environments, particularly when the recommendation accuracy reaches 50%, achieving an approximately 7.05% higher hit ratio compared to the OFTRL algorithm, as demonstrated through experiments involving both synthetic and real-world data.

articleTitle: A Study on Technology Selection for Student Attendance in Classroom Environment Based on Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In modern educational management, utilizing facial recognition technology for student attendance can significantly improve attendance efficiency and accuracy, thereby enhancing teaching effectiveness. There are many attendance technologies available in classroom environments, making the adoption of an efficient and accurate technique increasingly important. This study focuses on evaluating and comparing four versions within the YOLO series - YOLOv5nu, YOLOv6n, YOLOv7-tiny, and YOLOv8n - in terms of performance in classroom environments. The research implements these models in the same classroom environment with similar datasets, comprehensively comparing them in aspects such as recognition accuracy, processing speed, loss functions, and performance metrics. Performance on the same dataset is analyzed and compared. Results indicate that despite each model having its advantages, based on two core metrics: mean average precision (mAP) and F1-Score, YOLOv7-tiny and YOLOv8n exhibit the best overall performance. These research findings provide empirical evidence for selecting appropriate facial recognition technology, contributing to further advancements in intelligent classroom management systems.

articleTitle: Pixel-level Monocular Depth Estimation Based on Global-local Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To address the issue of insufficient extraction of global features in CNN monocular depth estimation networks, leading to scale ambiguity and object edge ambiguity in predicted depth maps, this paper presents a pixel-level monocular depth estimation method based on global-local feature fusion. Multiple pre-trained Transformer blocks are employed as encoders to extract global features at multiple scales. Additionally, a global area enhancement module based on pyramid pool is designed to increase the receptive field of the network, providing effective global context prior for in-depth scene analysis and enhancing the network's ability to obtain feature information. Furthermore, a feature fusion module based on large kernel convolution attention is proposed to better utilize global and local features such as shape and texture, refining semantic scenes and improving the global contours of depth maps. Finally, an adaptive distribution depth interval and estimation module are designed according to the requirements of depth features in different regions of the scene. The depth information is estimated by the probability distribution of pixels and linear combination of discrete pixels, resulting in clearer predicted depth maps with detailed and smooth object outlines.

articleTitle: A DRL-Based Intelligent Task Offloading and Caching Strategy for IIoT in MEC
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In IIoT (Industrial Internet of Things) systems, diverse smart devices generate various types of computational tasks, often with low latency requirements. Leveraging computation offloading techniques in MEC (Mobile Edge Computing), these tasks can be sent to MEC servers for auxiliary computing. However, the dynamic changes in the environment and the increasing number of smart devices in the system lead to competition for the limited resources on the servers, making it crucial to develop rational offloading strategies. Motivated by this, to ensure efficient and stable operation of IIoT systems, we design intelligent offloading and task caching strategies for single-edge mobile networks to reduce the overall execution latency of intelligent tasks. This paper establishes a system model from three perspectives: task offloading, task caching, and task queue scheduling, and formulates a joint optimization problem for task offloading and task caching. We transform the interaction process of the system into a Markov decision process (MDP) and propose a low-latency scheduling strategy based on DRL (Deep Reinforcement Learning). At each time slot, this strategy collects dynamic environment information and reference task priority values to make offloading and caching decisions. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm achieves rapid and stable convergence and effectively reduces the completion latency of intelligent tasks.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aircraft Positioning System Based on Multi-Source Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of UAV and sensor industry technology has led to the widespread use of UAVs in various industries. However, there are significant limitations in the ability to carry only a single sensor for positioning, and it is challenging to ensure the accurate positioning and stable flight of UAVs in complex environments. To address this issue, this design proposes a multi-source data fusion positioning algorithm using a quadrotor UAV as a platform. The algorithm employs the extended Kalman filter (EKF) to integrate the inertial measurement unit (IMU) and binocular camera odometry data to derive precise three-dimensional attitude information. Concurrently, it combines with the Gmapping algorithm to integrate the two-dimensional laser point cloud data to achieve the accurate positioning of the quadcopter UAV. Experimental results demonstrate that the algorithm enables the UAV to achieve accurate positioning indoors while simultaneously meeting the functional requirements of one-key take-off and precise hovering of the quadcopter UAV. This method effectively overcomes the limitations of a single sensor for UAVs and provides a feasible solution for its application in complex environments.

articleTitle: Multi-Agents on a Muti-Layer Network A MADDPG-Based Method
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of computing ability, reinforcement learning algorithms have been introduced to solve problems in fields such as autonomous driving, robotics, and game theory. Due to the fact that the agents in these fields need to propose effective cooperation or competitive strategies timely, the multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithms are proposed to help agents to face the dynamic and complex environments. In this paper, a multiagent testing environment was constructed to validate the representative algorithm of multi-agent reinforcement learning, MADDPG. And the result showcases its superior performance and stability. These findings are expected to provide valuable insights into enhancing the efficiency of multi-agent configurations.

articleTitle: Aircraft-Based Maritime Emergency Communication Resource Deployment Method
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the increasing maritime activities, the rapid response capability in maritime emergency communication becomes increasingly vital. Research on enhancing the response speed of maritime emergency communication holds significant theoretical and practical value. In this context, aircraft, owing to their high speed and efficiency, emerge as potential carriers of maritime emergency communication resources (MECR). The selection of MECR deployment sites is pivotal to achieving rapid responses. To meet the response time requirements in maritime emergency communication, a multi-objective optimization site selection model is proposed. This model takes into account the hierarchical coverage of both drones and helicopters, considering their differing coverage capabilities. Genetic algorithms are employed to solve this model. Through a case analysis in the Bohai Sea region, this paper validates the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Image Endmember Extraction Algorithm Based on Manifold Learning and Superpixel Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Endmember extraction is the crucial process of hyperspectral unmixing. In this study, we introduce a nonlinear endmember extraction algorithm for hyperspectral remote sensing image analysis. The algorithm use the manifold learning technique to acquire the intrinsic nonlinear structure of hyperspectral data, and extract the endmembers based on convex simplex theory in low-dimensional manifolds. In order to achieve better manifold representations and reduce the computational burden, superpixel feature extraction is performed on the original hyperspectral data. Experimental results on synthetic and real data demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: PMTL: Personality-Aware Multitask Learning Model for Emotion Recognition in Conversation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the field of affective computing, Emotion Recognition in Conversations (ERC) has gained increasing attention. The relationship between emotions and personality traits during conversations is a complex challenge. However, most conversational context models in ERC do not consider the speaker's background. Few works focus on personality traits and their impact on emotion recognition. To address this, we introduce PMTL, a multitask learning model that synergizes emotion recognition with sentiment analysis. PMTL incorporates personality traits into the emotional transition modeling process, leveraging the VAD emotional space to map contextual interdependencies and speaker-specific nuances. Our model outperforms existing models on benchmark datasets. Through an ablation study, we validate the efficacy of each component within PMTL, thereby demonstrating the significance of incorporating personality traits into emotion recognition tasks.

articleTitle: Mix-CL: Semi-Supervised Continual Learning for Network Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: We present an approach to address the evolving and complex challenges of network security in contemporary network environments. Our proposed framework integrates continual learning and semi-supervised learning techniques tailored for network traffic intrusion detection. We begin by assessing the effectiveness of conventional continual learning methods, such as LwF, ER, iCaRL, and DER, when faced with limited supervised data. Then we proposed Mix-CL, a semi-supervised continual learning strategy based on MixMatch. Experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of our approach in scenarios where supervision is scarce, yielding robust and efficient models for continual learning. This research offers a novel insight and methodology to confront cybersecurity challenges.

articleTitle: Commodity Demand Forecasting of E-Commerce Merchants Based on the Stacking Fusion Model
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rise of e-commerce platforms and the continuous expansion of market scale, how to supply and distribute and manage the goods in e-commerce supporting warehouses is a factor that needs to be considered by every merchant. In order to reduce merchants' inventory costs and fulfill commitments on time, this paper establishes a forecasting model based on the Stacking fusion model combined with grid search. With “merchant - warehouse - commodity” as a time series about commodity demand on the time axis, the Stacking fusion model is established. It integrates XGBoost, LishtGBM and Catboost machine learning models, and adopts grid search and cross-validation methods for parameter optimization. Prediction accuracy, recall rate, goodness of fit coefficient, root-mean-square error and 5% error accuracy were used to evaluate the prediction performance.

articleTitle: Research on Color Segmentation Algorithms in Visual Communication Technology for Human-Computer Interaction Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of human-computer interaction (HCI) systems, color segmentation technology, as a crucial aspect of visual communication, plays an indispensable role in achieving efficient human-computer interaction. To this end, we propose a color segmentation algorithm tailored for visual communication in human-computer interaction systems. In this algorithm, we first introduce a K-means parameter algorithm that adapts to the RGB histogram to extract color peak points and determine the initial classification centers. Subsequently, we devise a joint feature similarity calculation algorithm that comprehensively considers the similarity of pixel blocks across multiple dimensions, including color, texture, and spatial location. This ensures meticulous and precise segmentation of color features. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed algorithm exhibits significant advantages in both segmentation effectiveness and computational efficiency compared to other methods, providing powerful new support for the further advancement of the human-computer interaction field.

articleTitle: ECOA: An Enhanced Crayfish Optimization Algorithm for Real-World Engineering Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The Crayfish Optimization Algorithm (COA) is a new metaheuristic algorithm that has been proposed in recent years. While it has a strong local search ability, its global search ability is weak. this paper presents an improved version called ECOA. Firstly, a novel scaling factor is introduced into lens imaging learning to enhance the diversity of the population. Secondly, a dynamic convergence curve is proposed, which broadens the search range and accelerates the convergence speed. Thirdly, a novel feeding strategy is proposed to enhance the local optimization ability of the algorithm. The performance of ECOA is demonstrated through the reducer design problem. The results show that the proposed algorithm has better global search ability and local search ability than the other four state-of-the-art metaheuristic algorithms.

articleTitle: Traffic Surveillance License Plate Recognition System in Heavy Rainfall
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In adverse weather conditions such as heavy rainfall, visibility obstruction significantly reduces the image quality captured by surveillance cameras, impacting the recognition of vehicles and their license plates. This leads to ineffective monitoring of traffic violations and other situations. To address this issue, we have developed a vehicle and license plate detection and recognition system specifically designed for heavy rain conditions, which consists of three main components: (a) image de- raining, (b) license plate localization, and (c) license plate information extraction. For image de-raining, we have introduced the NeRD-Rain algorithm and created a de-raining dataset containing vehicles by adding random noise. We then utilized pre- trained models for transfer learning. In the license plate localization stage, we employed the YOLOv5 model for accurate localization of license plates. Lastly, for license plate information extraction, we constructed a character extraction network. Through experiments conducted on our dataset, the complete version and lightweight version of the de-raining module achieved PSNR scores of 38.42 and 36.82, respectively. Moreover, the accuracy of license plate information extraction reached 96.33%.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, a traffic sign detection algorithm based on the improved YOLOv8 model is proposed to solve the problem of small traffic sign targets and high environmental interference common in road traffic scenarios. The algorithm utilizes the CBAM attention mechanism to improve the network's ability to perceive small targets, and also utilizes Wise-IoU to replace the original CIoU loss function to train the model, which improves the accuracy and speed. Experimental results show that our improved model performs well in terms of mean average precision (mAP) metrics in the validation of the CCTSDB 2021 traffic sign dataset, with 85.4% for mAP50 and 56.8% for mAP50:95. Compared with the baseline model, our improved model improved by 6.9 percentage points and 7.2 percentage points on mAP50 and mAP50:95, respectively. Therefore, our improved model has significant advantages in traffic sign detection in complex road scenarios and provides effective improvements in the traffic sign detection task.

articleTitle: Research on Improving Sparrow Search Algorithm for Charging Station Site Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to facilitate the charging of new energy vehicle users and alleviate the users' mileage anxiety. In this paper, the sparrow search algorithm is easy to fall into the local optimization and other problems, through the introduction of the degree of strategy to improve, with the user charging distance cost and charging station construction cost minimization as the goal of framing the charging station site selection model, the use of improved sparrow search algorithm to select the appropriate charging station construction location, the results prove that the method proposed in this paper can be selected to the appropriate location and the lowest cost of construction.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Cluster Communication Routing Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To address the efficiency issue of high-speed motion communication in unmanned aerial vehicle clusters, an improved OLSR multipath routing protocol algorithm based on node idle parameters and designed in conjunction with MAC and network layers under high dynamic conditions was proposed. The algorithm was simulated and analyzed on the OPNET simulation platform. The results indicate that the algorithm has improved network latency and data delivery rate, which has reference significance for improving the efficiency of high-speed flight communication in unmanned aerial vehicle clusters.

articleTitle: Seismic Magnitude Determination Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Earthquakes are a natural disaster that have serious impacts on human society. Accurately determining the magnitude of earthquakes is crucial for understanding their danger and taking appropriate measures. Traditional methods for seismic magnitude determination face challenges such as data complexity and computational complexity. With the development of deep learning technology, convolutional neural networks have been introduced as a powerful tool for pattern recognition in the field of seismology. This study aims to investigate the effectiveness of seismic magnitude determination methods based on convolutional neural networks. In this study, we designed a deep convolutional neural network model to automatically extract features from seismic waveform data and estimate magnitudes. We conducted experiments using a large-scale earthquake dataset from seismic monitoring networks for validation. The experimental results demonstrate that compared to traditional methods, seismic magnitude determination based on convolutional neural networks achieves significant improvements in accuracy and generalization ability.

articleTitle: A Fast Transient DCDC Buck Circuit Applied to Cable Gas Thermal Degradation Detection Device
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive constant conduction DCCDC buck circuit with fast transient response is proposed, which can be applied to the current cable accessory thermal degradation gas detection device for the need of fast response of the power supply. The DCDC buck circuit proposed in this paper has an input voltage range of 1.6V-1.8V, an output voltage range of 0.6V-1.2V, and an output voltage accuracy of up to 1.85%, and an adaptive constant on-time module to make the operating frequency fixed at 1MHz to improve the conversion efficiency of the circuit. In addition, the DCDC buck circuit proposed in this paper has a minimum output voltage change of 10.4mV when the input voltage jumps, a minimum linear tuning rate of 5.77%/V, and a response time of 1.3us, and a minimum output voltage change of 38.3mV when the load current jumps from 0.2A to 1A with each other, a minimum load tuning rate of 5.32%/V, and a transient response time of only 2.9us.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Key Influencing Factors of Phased Array Antenna Directivity Diagram
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the unique advantage that phased array antenna can quickly scan its beam in different Spaces without rotation, this paper first analyzes the working principle of linear array and planar array phased array antenna, derives the antenna directivity function formula, determines the key factors that may affect the phased array antenna directivity function, and then establishes the basic phased array antenna model and performs simulation experiments. By comparing the theoretical analysis with the simulation experiment results, the variation law of the antenna directivity diagram with various factors is obtained. The research results are of great significance for understanding the various technologies of phased array radar and grasping the practical application of phased array radar.

articleTitle: Full-Duplex RoF System Based on DPMZM and Polarization Multiplexed 16-Fold Frequency mmWave
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the commercialization of the fifth generation mobile communication system and the arrival of the future sixth generation mobile communication system, people are more and more demanding on communication technology. Millimeter wave of high frequency band has become the inevitable choice of current 5G communication. Generating millimeter-wave signals in the optical domain is more cost-effective than in the electrical domain. The optical millimeter wave technology system using external modulation scheme is stable and cost-effective. It has important scientific research significance and practical value. A 16-frequence full-duplex millimeter wave system based on dual-parallel Mach Zender modulator and polarization multiplexing is constructed, and its transmission performance is analyzed.

articleTitle: Traffic Network Modeling for Airway Segments Based on Association Rule Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Flight safety is the primary task of the aviation industry, to improve the flight flow under the premise of ensuring safety is the current aviation research hotspot. In order to effectively optimize the airport route segment network and improve the route segment flight aircraft flow. This paper realizes the associated data mining by improving the FP-Growth algorithm, aiming to realize the suitability of the flight traffic of airport group route segments with the required route segment network. The simulation experiments are based on the route segment peak day traffic dataset, and 50 key route segments are mined according to the correlation analysis, and the route segment network model is constructed and the network characteristics are analyzed. The results show that the key route segment network mined by the improved FP-Growth algorithm has better connectivity and robustness, which provides a new idea for the research of airport cluster route segment network.

articleTitle: Contrast Preserving Grayscale Method Based on Pseudo-Huber Loss
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In response to the poor robustness of current image grayscale methods in handling outliers, this paper proposes a new contrast-preserving grayscale method based on Pseudo Huber loss. The method aims to improve the robustness of the algorithm based on maintaining the image contrast and maximally preserving the detailed features of the color image. The transformation model takes into account the fact that the Pseudo-Huber function is a combination of the robustness possessed by the MAE function and the continuous derivability of the MSE function, and as a result, a target energy function with Pseudo-Huber smoothing properties is constructed in the grayscaling model. Thus, the accuracy and color contrast of the detailed features are realistically maintained. To ensure the timeliness of the algorithm, the grayscaled discrete model is built using a discrete search solver. Experimental results show that the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm on the dataset proves the robustness of the method, and outperforms the state-of-the-art methods in both qualitative and quantitative metrics.

articleTitle: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis for Virtual Reality Roaming System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Through sentiment analysis technology, NPCs (Non-Player-Controlled Character) in virtual reality roaming system are able to recognize the user's emotional state and react accordingly. In aspect-based sentiment analysis, NLP techniques often use manually constructed features combined with machine learning models for classification. However, these methods are complex in feature engineering and lack generalisation capabilities. At the same time, traditional models often ignore the importance of local context for the correct classification of the sentiment polarity of aspect term, and process all input data indiscriminately. In order to solve the above problems and improve the processing efficiency of aspect-based sentiment analysis, an attention weight decay mechanism is proposed. On this basis, a multi-module model is constructed by fusing BERT, BiLSTM and TextCNN, and the performance of the model is verified experimentally. This model can be better applied to virtual reality roaming systems.

articleTitle: SMNet: One-Shot Method for Solving the Cross-Room Problem in Room Closure Monitoring Based on White Noise
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Room Closure Monitoring based on white noise has attracted much attention due to its advantages such as low cost. However, in practical application, the monitoring model often can't show good generalization performance in a new room due to the distribution difference caused by the size of the room and the location. Previous studies did not access the target room data by default, resulting in limited performance of the model in the target room. In this paper, a one-shot model called SMNet is proposed, which only needs to provide one positive and one negative sample to achieve good performance in the target room. SMNet determines the label of unknown samples by determining the relationship between unknown samples and known samples through specimen matching network. Meanwhile, in order to ensure the representativeness of known samples, this paper uses contrastive learning to align similar samples in the embedded space to eliminate the influence of task-independent factors. In this paper, SMNet is compared with its baseline and the classic one-shot network Similarity Net on the WNRoom dataset, and both results are superior.

articleTitle: A Functional Data Classifier Based on Bonferroni Mean Fuzzy K-Nearest Centroid Neighbor
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Instead of representing data as vectors of fixed dimensions, functional data is represented as functions or curves. Functional data analysis can reduce the dimensionality by feature extraction to process and analyze high-dimensional, dynamic, and complex data. Compared to traditional classification methods, functional data classification provides a higher level of data information extraction by considering the entire function or curve rather than individual data points. This article proposes a functional data classifier based on Bonferroni Mean fuzzy K-nearest Centroid Neighbor. Specifically, the features of the data are first extracted using functional data analysis to obtain the basis coefficients, which are used as inputs to the classifier. Then, the Bonferroni Mean based Fuzzy K-Nearest Centroid Neighbor classifier is used to compute the fuzzy membership of the unclassified samples in each category and classify the samples according to the membership of different categories. We tested the performance of the proposed classifier using eight different real functional datasets. Based on the experimental results, compared with the other six functional data classifiers, the proposed method has the best overall classification performance on all datasets.

articleTitle: Anti-Mirror Monitoring Method of Converter Station Based on Infrared Image Sequence Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the research of converter station anti misentry monitoring, the common monitoring methods are affected by weather factors, the monitoring behavior characteristics are incomplete, and the environmental applicability of the monitoring methods needs to be further improved. In order to solve this problem, a converter station anti misentry monitoring method based on infrared imaging technology and time sequence is proposed. The infrared detector is used to collect the monitoring image and correct the non-uniform image to make the monitoring image have linear characteristics. According to the time sequence characteristics of the image, the change characteristics of two adjacent frames are detected. A variety of calculation functions are introduced to obtain the continuous change characteristics, which are used as input, and the monitoring image state at the next time is predicted through the designed state model, So as to ensure the real-time monitoring and timely early warning of misentry behavior. The experimental results show that the monitoring method based on infrared imaging technology and timing can still ensure the integrity of monitoring image features and obtain accurate monitoring image information under different weather conditions. The environmental applicability of this method is better.

articleTitle: Impact of Digital Modulation on Optical Fiber Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In this study, we investigate the impact of modulation order on optical fiber communication systems using MATLAB simulation. The research explores the balance between high-order and low-order modulation strategies to optimize the application of modulation order in optical fiber networks. By evaluating the effects on speed, quality, and capacity, our study highlights how different modulation orders can be effectively utilized in standard communication settings and tailored to specific application demands. Key considerations include optical fiber attributes, modulation methods, signal processing approaches, and network configurations. The findings contribute to the ongoing efforts to enhance the efficiency of optical fiber networks in our rapidly advancing information society.

articleTitle: Research on High-Precision Displacement Monitoring System Based on GNSS
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In recent years, geological disasters such as debris flows and landslides have occurred frequently across the country. Real-time monitoring and early warning of geological disasters has been a long-term research content. This article analyzes and studies the requirements for surface displacement monitoring and the application of RTK technology in GNSS systems, and designs a set of high-precision GNSS displacement monitoring devices and online monitoring platforms based on RTK to realize the monitoring of address disasters through high-precision displacement monitoring of the ground surface. and early warning. The device uses 4G to communicate differential data messages, which can eliminate the construction difficulty of deploying base stations. At the same time, it can realize real-time online equipment and real-time upload of monitoring data, which can effectively improve the real-time and accuracy of early warning monitoring.

articleTitle: Momentum Analysis Based on Wavelet Neural Network: Inspiration from Quantum Physics and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This study applies wavelet transform from quantum physics to neural networks to analyze the impact of momentum and other physical parameters on sports match outcomes. The model performed well in predicting the 2023 Carlos Alcaraz vs. Novak Djokovic match, with an MSE of 0.0004 on the test set, indicating high accuracy. By leveraging the wavelet transform's ability to handle non-stationary signals, we enhanced the neural network's predictive capabilities. These results demonstrate the promising applications of neural networks in effectively predicting sports match outcomes.

articleTitle: Research on Small Viewing Angle Target Detection Algorithm of UAV Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the era of rapid development of science and technology, drones, as an intelligent tool for target detection, can help us to play a significant role in real-time detection of the ground, greatly reducing our manual and economic consumption, so as to improve the application of target detection in reality. There are some difficulties in small-size detection in practice. This paper uses drone data set and YOLOv8 algorithm in the field of deep learning to solve the problem of unsatisfactory small-size detection in the UAV detection process, and proposes a drone detection model with better effect by improving the original YOLOv8 algorithm.
