In this paper, Decoupled Head is used to replace the original YOLO Head for decoupled operation, and the two tasks are calculated separately, so that it can more accurately detect small objects that are not easy to recognize, and better meet the detection requirements. In the part of target locating loss function, the CIOU loss function of YOLOv8 is replaced with GIOU, which further speeds up the convergence speed of the network. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has an 10.2% improvement over the baseline model, which significantly improves the detection accuracy of small-size targets. Compared with the original YOLOv8 algorithm and previous YOLO series algorithms, it is found that the improved algorithm in this paper has better detection effect and can accurately identify small-size target groups within the range, providing a new idea for further research on UAV detection technology.

articleTitle: Image Recognition Method and Device for Trace Scenarios Based on LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The technique and apparatus for image recognition for trace situations presented in this research are based on the LSTM neural network and fall within the category of artificial intelligence/big data (image recognition/intelligent work order). When the work order system handles website access fault work orders (unreachable, packet loss, large delay, etc.), in the network monitoring and operation maintenance of telecommunication operators, the screenshots of routing trace information provided by customers cannot be directly used, and manually writing trace information is time-consuming and laborious. Furthermore, the total recognition accuracy for IP is low when using the conventional computer vision method for OCR recognition. Thus, based on work order annotation data and adaptive feature extraction, this research suggests an OCR recognition technique and device for work order trace information. The recognition accuracy is increased by the addition of an adaptive classifier and an LSTM neural network training process. This satisfies the high accuracy requirements of trace image recognition in the operators' online production environment and makes it easier to analyze network topology and fault location in the future using the trace recognition results.

articleTitle: Design of a Digital Platform for the Grand Canal National Cultural Park Based on the B/S Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This article proposes an efficient and secure overall framework construction technology for the platform. Based on the B/S structure, this article innovatively develops a new system, effectively addressing the limitations in data processing and reducing server overload and maintenance costs. In terms of programming technology, the lightweight and customizable development is achieved by adopting the SSM framework (Spring MVC, Spring, MyBatis) based on J2EE. The platform design includes a real-time monitoring module and a data module, integrating advanced technologies such as drones and remote sensing, and ensuring data security and efficient collection through data encryption and 3S technology. The archive management adopts MySQL, MongoDB, and TDengine to meet the diverse data storage needs. This research provides strong technical support for platform construction.

articleTitle: Enhancing Generalization Capability Through Local Features Reintegration for Adversarial Perturbations
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the pervasive integration of deep learning in computer vision, the sensitivity of deep neural networks to adversarial samples emerges as a major challenge. Adversarial attacks, particularly in black-box scenarios, leverage the transferability of perturbations. However, target attacks encounter overfitting challenges during transfer attacks on the source model, potentially leading to significantly reduced success rates and an overestimation of the victim model's robustness. To tackle this, our paper introduces the Local Feature Reintegration (LFR) method—an innovative approach integrated during optimization. LFR combines local clean features with adversarial features, presenting a novel method for generating universal adversarial perturbations. The process includes storing and recombining local clean features with local adversarial or global adversarial features during inference. Furthermore, a feature similarity loss is designed to maximize similarity between randomly cropped local regions and adversarial samples. This ensures that features from adversarial perturbations gain a competitive edge over features from clean images in the local optimization competition, thereby enhancing the transferability of target attacks. LFR effectively addresses overfitting issues and seamlessly integrates into existing attack algorithms.

articleTitle: Enabling Information-Centric Web Services with a Web Server
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The drastic increase in Internet traffic has led to the emergence of different Internet architectures to serve content delivery and user demand. Traditional architectures such as web cache and Content Delivery Networking (CDN), have high deployment costs and require several steps to process users' requests. Also, there is a conflict that these architectures focused on content in the network but were designed to apply web services in host-to-host networks, so they cannot support dynamic network scenarios well. Information-Centric Networking (ICN) can address the limitations and better support web services based on content rather than location. In this paper, we proposed a web server, which enables Information-Centric web services. It takes advantage of ICN, which integrates content delivery as a native network feature. To combine web services semantics and ICN semantics, we design Information-Centric web semantics, presenting in ICN Name and packet directly. We also design Information-Centric web primitives to realize different types of web services in the web server. The evaluation demonstrates that this approach provides a practical solution to enable information-centric web services in the web server.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Design of Tujia Brocade Patterns Based on Style Migration Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: To inherit and develop the non-heritage Tujia brocade, promote digital protection and innovative design, and cater to the social development trend and public demand, this paper, based on the research and analysis of the historical development of Tujia brocade pattern brocade and the characteristics of pattern, adopts the style migration algorithm of AI technology to extract the patterns and patterns of Tujia brocade and carry out the digitization and stylization of derivation design, and designs work which retains the characteristics of Xilan The work is more creative and visually effective while retaining the characteristics of the Siilan Kapu pattern. This study not only explores the digital design inheritance and protection path of Tujia brocade but also improves the integration of science and technology with art to a certain extent, thus further promoting the dissemination and development of Tujia culture.

articleTitle: Haptic Interaction Method Based on Vision with Object Details
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Haptic human-computer interaction technology is a key step towards natural human-computer interaction through multisensory fusion. Haptic rendering for object details can significantly enhance the naturalness and immersion of human-computer interaction. This paper proposed an online visual-haptic integrated 6DOF haptic rendering method for interaction with the details of objects. Based on detailed surface images captured by sensors, our algorithm achieved the online construction of object details' 3D mesh model. Subsequently, an improved adaptive medial axis approximation method is utilized to build a sphere-tree model of the object details in real time. Collision detection based on the sphere-tree model and constraint-based six-degree-of-freedom collision response are utilized for force and torque calculations, which are then fed back to the operator's hands by the haptic device. Experimental results demonstrate that this algorithm meets the requirements of realism, real-time performance, and effectiveness, achieving online real-time haptic interaction for details of objects.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation and Prediction Model of Vehicle Interior Sound Quality Based on EEG
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In view of the fact that EEG (electroencephalogram) signals can reflect people's psychological state under auditory stimulation, the interior noise is used as the auditory stimulation of the evaluator. A method of establishing an evaluation and prediction model of interior sound quality based on EEG signals is proposed, which takes the relaxation degree as the evaluation index, the EEG features extracted from the relaxation degree in the field of EEG as the input, and the subjective evaluation results as the output. By extracting the power spectral density of the EEG feature a(8-13Hz) wave strongly related to the relaxed state, the mean and variance of the two time domain features are used as the feature input, and the subjective evaluation results are used as the output to construct different prediction classification models. By comparing their prediction accuracy, the CNN classification prediction model performed best at 55.56%, followed by KNN prediction accuracy of 49.50%.

articleTitle: Byzantine fault-tolerant consensus algorithm based on local temporary consensus and global confirmation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the Byzantine fault-tolerant consensus algorithm when the number of nodes is too large, there are problems such as a large amount of data exchange, slow consensus speed, and security degradation caused by proxy nodes, based on threshold signatures, a new Byzantine fault-tolerant consensus algorithm based on local temporary consensus and global confirmation is proposed. Nodes divide into different zones based on their geographical location, the algorithm conducts temporary consensus among zones in parallel, and all nodes participate in global confirmation together, reducing the amount of network data exchange during the consensus process while improving consensus speed and security.

articleTitle: Utilizing the Entropy Weighting Method to Determine Objective Weights in Robot Trajectory Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Optimizing trajectories of collaborative robots is crucial to ensure the efficiency and safety of human-robot interactions in many manufacturing industries. This paper introduced an entropy weighting-based method for determining objective weights in trajectory optimization. Virtual simulations were conducted obtaining datasets of robot trajectory optimization so that, the application scope of the proposed weight determination method could be expanded. The validity of this method was affirmed through comparative simulation experiments. The results demonstrated that in maneuvers in the negative z-axis direction, optimized weights significantly outperformed baseline weights in terms of energy consumption and nominal trajectory tracking, with scores of 0.97 versus 0.68, and 0.82 versus 0.54, respectively. This indicates a better performance than subjective weight setting method in enhancing the performance of collaborative robot trajectory optimization.

articleTitle: Adaptive K-Means Based Sampling Frequency Offset Compensation for Ultra-Wideband System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: An improved adaptive k-means algorithm is proposed for compensating sampling frequency offsets in multi-band orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (MB-OFDM) ultra-wideband over fiber (UWBoF) system. Simulation results show that the sampling frequency offsets (SFO) of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$+110$</tex> ppm and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 225$</tex> ppm can be compensated after 100 km of standard single-mode fiber (SSMF) propagation for 64 quadrantal amplitude modulation (QAM) and 16QAM, respectively, and the BER is lower than the hard-decision forward error correction (HD-FEC) threshold.

articleTitle: Matrix-Variate Beta Variational Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) are currently popular deep generative models that demonstrate powerful performance in various applications. However, VAEs have a tendency to vectorize data during encoding, which can result in the loss of structured information for matrix-based data, such as images. Some researchers have extended VAEs to develop matrix-based variational autoencoder methods, which have shown improved performance in handling image data. Building upon this work, we propose Matrix-variate beta VAEs, which can extract latent representations from raw matrix data in a fully unsupervised manner and effectively preserve the spatial information of the data. Through experiments conducted on standard image datasets, our method outperforms traditional vectorized and matrix-based VAEs.

articleTitle: Image Semantic Segmentation Algorithm Improved Based on DeepLabV3+
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: At present, the DeepLabV3+image semantic segmentation method is challenging to implement on embedded devices with limited processing power due to its complex computational requirements and memory requirements. When extracting image feature information, DeepLabV3+does not completely exploit multilevel information, which can lead to the loss of some details and reduce the accuracy of segmentation performance. Taking lightweight MobileNetV2 for the model backbone, this study suggests a better approach based on the DeepLabv3+ network. The Efficient Multi-Scale Attention (EMA) module is applied to high-level features to enable the network to obtain higher pixel-by-pixel attention to feature maps with high resolution. To capture long-range dependency relationships, the Strip Attention Module (SAM) takes the place of the global average pooling that is part of the ASPP module, and the Sampling-based Spatial Feature Calibration (SFC) module is used to fuse low-level and high-level features. Validation on the PASCAL VOC2012 dataset shows that the improved mIoU and mPA reach 72.35% and 83.14%, respectively. It can predict more refined semantic segmentation results, successfully lowering the model's complexity and raising segmentation accuracy.

articleTitle: Vibration Measurement Method Based on Speckle Amplification
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Digital image correlation method is widely used in vibration measurement as a high-precision, full-field non-contact optical measurement technology. Optical measurement systems are susceptible to environmental interference, which causes small jitter in the optical structure, which cannot be distinguished by visual observation, and poses a potential threat to the reliability of subsequent data analysis. Therefore, this paper proposes a vibration measurement method based on speckle magnification, combined with digital image correlation method and video motion magnification method, and realizes the visualization of weak vibration and eliminates external interference through the vibration posterior detection mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on PCB Defect Detection Based on Lightweight Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of convolutional neural network technology, machine vision and image processing technologies are increasingly used in the industrial field. Especially in the electronics manufacturing industry, PCB are used as core components, the quality of which is directly related to the performance and reliability of electronic products. Therefore, the use of machine recognition technology to detect PCB defects is gradually becoming a hot spot for research and application. In this paper, a novel algorithm based on the Faster R-CNN target detection network model - DWconv R-CNN is proposed. This algorithm adopts Shufflenet's feature extraction network, and uses DW convolutional module and channel mixing operation for feature extraction, which realises the lightweight of defect detection network. The simultaneous detection of defect location, category and confidence is accomplished. The experimental results show that the mAP performance index of DWconv R-CNN algorithm reaches 92.53%, and the parameter amount of DWconv RCNN (lite) is reduced to a quarter, which is deployed on the Raspberry Pi 4B edge computing device and achieves better accuracy and inference speed.

articleTitle: Spectral Attention Graph Convolutional Network for Hyperspectral Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) can handle feature information efficiently via an end-to-end manner, which is popularly exploited for hyperspectral image classification. However, using only the normal graph convolution structure cannot deeply detect neighborhood data relationship. To further explore neighborhood data relationship, we propose a spectral information attention graph convolutional network (SIAGCN). We employ the graph convolutional network efficiently to acquire and gather spectral-spatial information. Then, spectral information attention (SIA) module is added to effectively explore the significance of spectral band and enhance the feature acquisition ability of GCN. Finally, we employ a broad learning network to enhance the width expansion. Experiments demonstrate that SIAGCN exceeds the comparison models.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Automatic Text Classification Algorithm Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, the Internet is filled with massive text data, how to efficiently manage, use, and understand these text data is a current research hotspot. Traditional manual text categorization methods require a lot of manpower and time, and automated text categorization can save a lot of human resources and improve processing efficiency. In this paper, we first preprocess the text data, including the steps of word splitting, removing deactivated words, etc., and then use the plain Bayesian, CNN, and LSTM to extract its features from the text to represent it into computer-recognizable data, and the experimental results on a large-scale real dataset show that the three algorithms perform slightly differently on different categories after multilevel feature learning and representation learning. Then the three categories of algorithms are compared and analyzed, and the idea of subsequent algorithm improvement is proposed.

articleTitle: Secrecy Performance of the Multi-UAVs Communication Network Applying Deep-Q Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) communication is recognized as one of the promising candidates for 6G due to its effectiveness, adaptability, and rapid deployment characteristics, particularly in emergency scenarios or on complex terrain. Physical layer security for this UAV network is also an interesting topic. Thus, in this paper, we investigate the secrecy performance of the ground base station-UAV communication network that serves multi-ground users in the presence of some eavesdroppers. Moreover, to decline the influence of Eavesdroppers and boost the security effectiveness of our proposed model, we propose the application of deep-Q-learning to control the flight trajectory of UAVs based on distance and AN signal is aimed to. Furthermore, the experimental result is performed to highlight the effects of important system parameters on secrecy performance.

articleTitle: Multimodal Enhanced Sentiment Analysis with Hierarchical Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Multi-modal sentiment analysis (MSA), as a hot research topic in the fields of natural language processing, affective computing, and multimedia analysis, has gradually become an important method for sentiment analysis in social networks, especially in combining text and image modalities for data analysis. However, existing studies suffer from the issue of ineffective fusion of multimodal sentiment features. In this paper, we propose a method for multimodal enhanced sentiment analysis using hierarchical feature extraction (ME-SAHFE). When extracting text features using RoBERTa, our method further extracts features from each layer output by employing a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to enhance the representation capability of text features. Subsequently, the extracted text features are concatenated with image features and inputted into a multilayer perceptron (MLP) for effective fusion. Our method achieves significant improvements in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score in sentiment classification on the MVSA-Multi dataset.

articleTitle: Improved Scattering Autocorrelation Imaging Method Based on Deep Learning Denoising
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Scatter autocorrelation imaging technique based on optical memory effect is an effective approach to perform noninvasive scattering imaging of single-frame scatter patterns. However, due to the complexity of real experimental environments, the scattering pattern actually acquired by the incoherent optical path system will be interfered by a large amount of noise from different sources, thus affecting further target reconstruction. Based on the derivation of the physical process of the scattering autocorrelation algorithm, the background noise has the same structural characteristics, and we believe that it can be learned. Taking advantage of the wide application of deep learning in the field of image denoising, we designed deep denoising networks to be trained with simulated speckle pattern and accomplished a better reconstruction of the original target in the actual acquired scattering pattern.

articleTitle: KGAT-MRC: A Knowledge Graph and Attention Mechanism-Based Model for Machine Reading Comprehension
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Machine Reading Comprehension (MRC) has garnered significant attention in the field of natural language processing. While the maritime domain lacks openly available MRC task models and corresponding datasets, resulting in a deficiency within existing models to provide accurate answers tailored to the maritime domain. In response to these issues, our work uses hand annotation and data augmentation to create the OurShipSet machine reading comprehension dataset, which is tailored for the maritime industry. Additionally, we propose the KGAT-MRC model, which integrates relevant knowledge triplets from the domain to enhance the understanding of text semantics. In order to mitigate the issue of noise introduced by incorporating knowledge triplets, this paper embeds the most relevant knowledge triplets to the questions, ensuring that the impact of noisy questions on the model is minimized through computation-based selection. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves an EM (Exact Match) score of 70.69% and an F1 score of 87.94%, representing improvements of 4.22% and 2.47% respectively over existing methods.

articleTitle: Multiple Cancer Types Classification Based on Gene Data Expression via Partial Binary Tree HTWSVM
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Cancer is a complex and diverse disease, whose heterogeneity makes precise treatment imperative. This can be accomplished by dividing cancer patients into different subtypes. However, there are great challenges using machine learning methods for multiple cancer types classification to improve the performance. In this manuscript, we propose a novel partial binary tree hybrid fuzzy twin support vector machine (PBT-HTWSVM) to solve cancer classification, which can improve the generalization performance by reducing the effect of noise data on the optimal classification surface. HTWSVM combines hypersphere SVM and twin support vector machine. To eliminate outliers, the hypersphere for positive and negative classes is created using hypersphere SVM with the shortest possible radius. TWSVM is used to classify the new samples by Hypersphere SVM. Furthermore, partial binary tree is generated according to separation degree of any two classes, then samples are trained and classified by HTWSVM at each root node in the partial binary tree. The method is applied to ten types of cancers based on gene expression data consisting of 1389 samples containing 20501 gene signatures. Compared with other classifiers such as KNN, RF, SVM and TWSVM, the results show that the method improves the classification performance of various tumors with less prediction error by contrasting accuracy and ROC indices significantly.

articleTitle: Neighborhood Sampling with Incremental Learning for Dynamic Network Embedding
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Learning the network embeddings incrementally is attracting significant attention due to the dynamic and stable evolutionary properties exhibited by real-world networks. Existing methods update node embeddings by selecting the affected nodes, encompassing both the directly and indirectly affected nodes belonging to their neighboring nodes. However, most of these approaches select all the neighbors at each hop as indirectly affected nodes, overlooking the similarity differences between nodes due to different local structure and the diminishing impact as the neighborhood hops increases. To address these challenges, a new model called Neighborhood Sampling with Incremental Learning for Dynamic Network Embedding (NSIL-DNE) is proposed. Specifically, we employ a node similarity metric to measure the influence on the neighbors, and establish a sampling ratio to effectively select the closely topologically related neighbors as indirectly affected nodes. Extensive experiments conducted on real datasets show that NSIL-DNE outperforms comparison methods. Additionally, the comparison of sampling strategies experiment confirms the efficacy of the node similarity approach. And parameter analyses demonstrate that the decay property of the influence with increasing number of the neighborhood hops and not all the neighboring nodes at the same hop are affected equally.

articleTitle: Multimodal Recognition of Landmarks Based on Vision Language Model
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the task of landmark recognition, the recognition accuracy is easily affected by factors such as lighting, angle, and season. Existing landmark recognition methods have poor ability to understand deep semantics and capture contextual relationships, resulting in low recognition accuracy. Moreover, some methods require complex preprocessing steps. To address the above issues, this paper proposes a multimodal landmark recognition method based on vision language model. The vision language pretraining model is used to make the model training more stable and accelerate the model convergence. The self-attention layer based on multi-scale fusion is used to adapt image features. Multimodal marker vectors are introduced to fine-tune prompt words, and feature fusion is carried out using gated cross-attention layer to make the model better understand the image-text correlation and improve the model prediction accuracy. The results of testing on the dataset show that the proposed method is superior to the current mainstream methods in terms of accuracy, and the accuracy of Top-1 and Top-5 can reach 80.72% and 92.16%.

articleTitle: A Semantic Segmentation Method Based on Multilevel Relational Distillation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This article proposes a multilevel relational distillation method, which focuses more on the spatial structure relationship of feature maps compared to traditional detection distillation. Compared with advanced network models, it has a more obvious segmentation effect on small targets in complex scenes. On the ADE20K dataset, the accuracy reached 75.93%, and on the Cityscapes validation set, the average intersection to union ratio was 74.12%, proving that the model has improved on various datasets and has strong universality.

articleTitle: Study on Pedestrian Detection Methods Based on Improved CBAM-YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In view of the problem of YOLOv7 detection accuracy, a pedestrian detection model improving YOLOv7 network is proposed. First, the backbone network is downsampled using modules constructed with SPPCSPC module and CBAM to reduce the loss of fine-grained feature information. Secondly, the multiscale detection capability of the model is enhanced by increasing the small-size detection layer. Then, the original CIoU loss function was replaced with the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{\alpha}-\mathbf{EIoU}$</tex> loss function to improve the pedestrian target positioning accuracy. Using the Crowdhuman dataset for training and testing, the experimental results show that the proposed algorithm improves 5.2% and 4.3% recall and average accuracy values over the original algorithm, respectively, which can effectively improve the accuracy of pedestrian detection in long-distance targets and dense scenarios.

articleTitle: The Bayesian Optimization of CNN Hyperparameters Based on Multi-Threaded Gaussian Process Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This study proposes a Bayesian optimization method that combines thread pooling with Gaussian process acceleration to optimize the hyperparameters of convolutional neural networks. In the experiment, this method showed significant advantages in hyperparameter tuning, as it can quickly find the optimal combination of hyperparameters and significantly reduce the validation set loss of the model. Compared to traditional Bayesian optimization strategies, the Bayesian optimization method combining Gaussian process acceleration and thread pooling reduces validation set loss by approximately 8.13%. By introducing a thread pool mechanism, computational efficiency has been improved, ensuring the stability of the model in a shorter period of time. This strategy has broad application prospects in the field of deep learning.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Sensor Network for Transmission Line Condition Monitoring based on 6LoWPAN
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Through effective condition monitoring, remote monitoring of transmission lines can be realized, and the efficiency of transmission line inspection can be greatly improved. Wireless communication technology is one of the core technologies of transmission line condition monitoring. At present, the standardization of various wireless communication technologies is not yet completed, and the interconnection between different manufacturers cannot be realized, which restricts the application effect of various monitoring devices. In this paper, data characteristics and transmission characteristics of various sensors are summarized for online monitoring of transmission lines. 6lowpan adaptation is carried out based on IEEE802.15.4 wireless communication protocol stack to realize time synchronization characteristics. Meanwhile, the protocol stack optimization and code coding are further considered for data burst reporting. Finally, based on the ARM M4 MCU and the RF chip supporting 433MHz band, the wireless communication module design and protocol stack transplantation are completed, supporting the long-distance and standardized wireless transmission of all kinds of data in the transmission line monitoring scenario.

articleTitle: Counterfactual-Driven Model Explanation Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Artificial intelligence has rapidly advanced, becoming an indispensable part of industries such as finance due to its high accuracy. However, the lack of explainability in “black box” models has restricted their further application in security-sensitive areas. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) addresses this issue, but many existing explanation techniques only output feature importance or contribution, and the quality of these explanations is not describable, which does not enhance user trust in the models. Counterfactual explanations describe the minimal changes in features required to alter predictions to predefined outputs, offering high interpretability and suitability for evaluating the necessity of features for decisions. This paper proposes a counterfactual-based explanation evaluation algorithm that considers both the model itself and counterfactual instances from the perspectives of necessity and sufficiency, generating a reliability score for specific explanations, enhancing decision-making transparency, and boosting user understanding and trust in AI systems. Experiments on a credit dataset have also validated the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A New Residual-Based Image Semantic Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper investigates a residual-based image semantic transmission system, which achieves high compression ratio image transmission by transmitting semantic map and residual map. In order to further improve the semantic transmission performance of the system under a given compression ratio, this paper proposes to add a new residual processing module to the system. This module includes two sub-modules: Semantic-based Patch Se-lection and Selective Zeroing. By applying different treatments to residuals of different categories, the proposed method effectively reduces the impact of residuals of low-proportion categories on the final performance. Simulation experiments demonstrate that compared with existing methods, the proposed method achieves better performance in terms of MIoU (Mean Intersection over Union) and FID (Fréchet Inception Distance).

articleTitle: A Wireless Data Transmission Scheme for Spacecraft Interior Based on the Combination of WiFi and ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Spacecraft have complex structures, numerous internal devices, and require mutual information exchange. The use of traditional bus methods will inevitably increase the weight and cost of the system, and reduce its flexibility. Wireless communication technology not only solves the problem of difficult wired wiring, but also reduces weight costs, and has been applied in fields such as environmental monitoring and intelligent buildings. This article proposes a wireless data transmission scheme for spacecraft internal parameters collection based on a combination of WiFi and ZigBee, and analyzes the feasibility and key technologies of this scheme.

articleTitle: Sub-Pixel Edge Detection Algorithm Based on Improved Zernike Moments
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In machine vision high-precision size detection, sub-pixel edge detection algorithm is often used, but the common sub-pixel detection algorithm has the disadvantages of low positioning accuracy and large computation. The model in the actual image is gradual edge instead of ideal step edge. In this case, a Zernike moment sub-pixel edge detection algorithm based on gradual edge model is proposed in this paper. Experimental results show that the traditional Zernike moment algorithm based on step edge model meets the requirements of noise immunity, high accuracy and strong real-time performance in machine vision measurement.

articleTitle: Research on Autonomous Navigation System of Monocular Robot Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This article aims to study the autonomous navigation system of monocular robots based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). This article first introduces the steps of data collection and preprocessing, ensuring the quality of input data. Secondly, the model design for feature extraction and environmental understanding using CNN was elaborated, including the selection of network structure and the determination of training methods. Elaborate on the specific implementation method of autonomous navigation algorithm that integrates perception, decision-making, and execution. The experiment shows that the CNN based autonomous navigation system for monocular robots proposed in this article has shown good performance in terms of accuracy, robustness, and real-time performance. This study is not only of great significance for in-depth academic research, but also has important guiding value for the practical application of intelligent robots in industry, agriculture, and service industries.

articleTitle: Optimizing Task Processing Efficiency in MEC Networks Through Cooperative Offloading and Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: As Internet of Things (IoT) devices continue to proliferate and users' demands for low-latency and compute-intensive services grow, mobile edge computing (MEC) can effectively reduce task processing delay and energy consumption by tasks offloading to the MEC server. In the context of an MEC network comprising IoT mobile device (IMD), neighboring IMDs, and MEC servers, we propose a joint cooperative partial offloading and resource allocation scheme that selects a neighboring IMD and an MEC server as offloading assistants to assist the IMD in processing tasks in MEC systems. Further, the allocation of IMD computing resources should also be taken into consideration. By jointly optimizing the offloading decision and computational resource allocation, we minimize the weighted sum cost of task processing delay and energy consumption of all IMDs as an optimization problem and solve the non-convex problem by a deep Q-network (DQN) algorithm. Extensive experimental results show that the proposed scheme can effectively reduce the cost compared to other baseline schemes.

articleTitle: Improvement of Small Object Detection Algorithm Based on YOLOv8n in Drone Scene
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Detecting small objects in images presents challenges due to their small size, limited pixel counts, and susceptibility to background interference, resulting in less than ideal detection performances with room for significant improvement. From the perspective of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), we propose a modified YOLOv8n-ours model to enhance small object detection performances. Main research initiatives include introducing ODConv and DCN modules to replace Conv and C2f modules in the backbone architecture, which improves the network's ability to learn multi-scale features compared to traditional convolutional layers. We designed a new Tiny-BiFPN structure in the model's neck area, significantly enhancing the model's ability to detect small-sized objects while reducing parameter counts. Experimental results on the VisDrone2019 dataset demonstrate that our proposed YOLOv8n-ours model achieves a 31.3% reduction in parameters compared to YOLOv8n. Additionally, improvements of 5.3% and 3.1% were observed in the mAP50 and mAP50:90 detection accuracy metrics, respectively, indicating strong performances.

articleTitle: Research on AI Chip Large Model Inference Testing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: At present, the performance of AI inference cards in the industry mainly depends on the specification parameters of the chip, and in practice, the performance of inference cards is also related to the inference optimization technology of the chip. In response to this issue, we conducted researches on the specification information of current mainstream chip manufacturers. On the basis of studying existing evaluation indicators, a performance measurement scheme was proposed by using latency and throughput of input output context of as performance indicators, and five products were tested. The experimental results indicate that this scheme can scientifically and reasonably quantitatively evaluate the performance and scalability of AI inference cards.

articleTitle: A Cardiac MRI Segmentation Method Based on Context Cascade Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Cardiac Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) segmentation plays a crucial role in clinical diagnosis, enabling accurate identification of cardiac lesions and abnormalities as well as quantification of various aspects of cardiac function by accurately segmenting structures such as the left ventricle, right ventricle, and myocardium. In recent years, numerous algorithms based on deep neural networks have been proposed for cardiac MRI segmentation. However, challenges still exist in refining features at each layer, preserving contextual local information, and enhancing global information. To address these issues, this study proposes a context cascade attention-based method for cardiac MRI segmentation. Firstly, PVTv2 is employed to capture remote dependencies within the encoder and facilitate feature extraction and representation. Secondly, a lightweight network incorporating a deep residual convolution module is constructed to fuse features using skip connections while leveraging cascade operations to refine layer-specific features through complementary information from different layers. Additionally, a contextual attention module is introduced to explore contextual information by retaining local details while compressing global information and suppressing unimportant areas to highlight salient features thereby achieving both retention of local information and enhancement of global information. Furthermore, model performance was evaluated using five-fold cross-validation demonstrating its robustness with improved accuracy in segmentation achieved through experimental results and visual analysis.

articleTitle: Purely Azimuthal UAV Passive Localization Based on a Triangular Model
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: When a cluster of UAVs executes formation flight, in order to maintain a good formation shape, a purely azimuthal passive localization method is usually used to adjust the UAVs that show positional deviations. This method reduces the emission of electromagnetic wave signals to the outside and enhances the stealthiness of the formation. We address the problem of localization using more frequent electromagnetic signal communications and propose a purely mathematical geometric method, triangulation, to determine UAV orientation by passively receiving signals. Finally, we test the model using small error data and observe that the model results have high accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi-Attention Based Sleep Staging Method for Single-Channel EEG Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Sleep staging techniques have made significant progress in recent years. Traditional machine learning methods mainly rely on multiple metrics, but their accuracy and robustness have some limitations. In recent years, a large number of deep learning automatic sleep classification algorithms based on single-channel electroencephalogram (EEG) signals have been widely proposed, and multiscale convolutional neural networks have been widely used in the field of sleep staging. However, multiscale convolutional neural networks only focus on local information and do not fully consider other features of EEG signals. To solve this problem, we introduce an attention mechanism in multiscale convolutional neural networks to effectively extract key features of EEG and significantly improve the performance of the network. We used the Sleep-EDFX dataset for testing and evaluation. The experimental results show that our method effectively improves the performance of sleep staging, especially in stage N1, and the overall accuracy, Recall, and PR metrics are improved.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation Algorithm Based on D3QN for Ultra-Large-Scale Connection Scenarios in the 6G Context
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the ultra-large-scale connectivity scenario of 6G, traditional resource allocation is limited by finite communication resources and complex propagation environments, leading to inefficient wireless resource allocation. To address this issue, this paper utilizes hypergraph theory to construct a conflict-free resource allocation model, combining deep reinforcement learning (DRL) with the conflict-free resource allocation model to propose a resource allocation algorithm based on Dueling Double Deep Q Network (D3QN). This algorithm aims to maximize the system's cumulative reward, using deep neural networks to select resource allocation strategies that maximize the expected long-term return, achieving conflict-free resource allocation in the 6G ultra-large-scale connectivity scenario. Simulation experiments show that the proposed algorithm improves network throughput by over 70% compared to random algorithms and over 56% compared to Q-Learning algorithms, increasing resource efficiency by up to 33.17% and 41.55%, effectively enhancing network performance.

articleTitle: Fire Truck Firefighting Path Planning Based on Prediction and Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the increasing global warming and extreme weather conditions, fires are becoming more frequent worldwide. Deep learning can be applied to fire prediction, while reinforcement learning can be applied to firefighting truck path planning. This paper proposes a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework incorporating a prediction module for planning firefighting truck routes. To achieve this goal, we utilize Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) to forecast future fire conditions from a temporal perspective, followed by employing MARL to plan firefighting truck paths based on both the current and future fire states. Furthermore, from a spatial perspective, we integrate MARL algorithms incorporating opponent modeling into firefighting path planning, enabling firefighting trucks to make action selections by considering predictions of other firefighting trucks' actions. Using the Mao-Xianmin model to simulate fire spread environment, our results demonstrate that our approach achieves effective firefighting path planning.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Reversible Desensitization Technology for Sensitive Data Based on Permission Control
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, data security and personal privacy protection have become increasingly important. This article proposes a dynamic reversible desensitization technology framework for sensitive data based on permission control, aiming to solve the problem of effectively protecting sensitive data while ensuring data availability. This technical framework combines dynamic permission control mechanism and reversible desensitization algorithm to achieve real-time protection and on-demand recovery of sensitive data. The research results indicate that this framework can provide complete data access for authorized users while ensuring data security, and is suitable for industries such as electricity, finance, healthcare, and government that have extremely high requirements for data security.

articleTitle: Secrecy Rate Optimization for Intelligent Reflecting Surface Assisted MIMO System using Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In the paper, we study the secrecy rate for intelligent reflecting surface (IRS)-assisted multiple input multiple output (MIMO) system by utilizing simulated annealing algorithm (SAA), where the existence of obstacles leads to the loss of direct links between the base station (BS) and users. To maximize the secrecy rate, we jointly optimize the digital precoding matrices and phase shift matrices of IRS under the power constraints. Unfortunately, we found that Optimization problem is a non convex problem that is difficult to solve directly. So we propose a collaborative optimization scheme using SAA and obtain the optimal vector. Based on the derived results, we reveal the influence of several physical parameters such as signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), the number of BS antennas, the number of IRS elements, and the eavesdroppers position on the secrecy rate. The simulation results demonstrated the proposed collaborative optimization effectively harness the potential of IRS while ensuring a certain level of efficiency for the secrecy rate. This provides an additional gain and effective security assurance for secure communication.

articleTitle: Application of DDPG Algorithm for Residual Structured Networks in Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The development of intelligent mobility and the spread of artificial intelligence have contributed to the widespread use of autonomous driving techniques. Among the various algorithms used in this field, Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG) algorithm is favoured by researchers. The DDPG algorithm may ignore some features in the deep learning of the network, slow updating of parameters, and lack of stability and learning efficiency of the algorithm. To overcome these problems, this study proposes the deep deterministic policy gradient (R-DDPG) algorithm with the introduction of residual blocks. By establishing an experience pool of successful samples, the algorithm improves the sampling utilisation, enhances the exploration strategy and improves the neural network training efficiency. The performance of the R-DDPG algorithm is evaluated on the TORCS racing simulation platform, which demonstrates that the algorithm is able to improve the learning efficiency of driving strategies in an autonomous driving task compared to existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Edge Computing Task Offloading Based on Game Theory for Space-Air-Ground Integrated Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This study investigates an efficient computational resource offloading mechanism based on game theory for space-air-ground integrated network (SAGIN). In the system for the LEO satellite, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) and users, parameters of time delay and energy consumption are considered to improve overall system performance. Moreover, based on the equilibrium of multilayer game theory, the resource allocation and pricing algorithm are taken into account to maximize system profit. Furthermore, based game algorithm (BGA) is proposed and compared with other benchmark methods such as random task offloading (RTO) and all user's tasks offloading (AUTO) to UAV in the system for performance analysis. Results show that the proposed BGA exhibits good convergence and outperforms, and thus provide useful information for design of SAGIN.

articleTitle: Research on Object Detection Algorithm Based on Twin Attention and Adaptive Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Object detection as a core task in computer vision faces enormous challenges, especially when dealing with small and dense objects. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an object detection algorithm based on the fusion of twin attention and adaptive features, which aims to improve the accuracy and stability of detection. The design of the twin attention mechanism can accurately capture the subtle changes in the object area and its surrounding background, significantly enhancing the algorithm's perception of the object, so that the submerged or occluded object can be effectively identified in a complex background. At the same time, the adaptive feature fusion technology introduced in this paper abandons the traditional simple splicing method, but dynamically adjusts the fusion strategy according to the importance of the feature map, and realizes the optimal utilization of different levels of feature information. This innovation makes the algorithm more intelligent and efficient in feature extraction and utilization, and further improves the accuracy and robustness of object detection. The experimental results on the PASCAL_VOC2007 data set show that the proposed algorithm achieves a significant improvement of 5% in average precision(mAP) compared with the benchmark YOLOv8 algorithm. This significant performance improvement not only proves the superiority of the proposed algorithm in object detection tasks, but also provides strong technical support for promoting the improvement of object detection performance in practical applications.

articleTitle: Extreme Gradient Boosting Based Railway Accident Type Prediction and Influencing Factors Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of unbalanced categories of railroad accidents and strong subjectivity of influencing factor analysis, an algorithm for predicting the types of railroad accidents and analyzing influencing factors based on Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) is presented. Firstly, according to the actual situation, the railroad accidents are divided into 10 types such as derailment, head on collision, etc., and the accident data are preprocessed with variable screening and feature coding; secondly, the accident type prediction model based on XGBoost is constructed to forecast the 10 types of railway accidents; finally, the influencing factors of railroad accidents are identified and analyzed according to the feature importance of the prediction model. The results show that the accuracy, recall, and F1score of the XGBoost prediction model are 0.84, 0.842, and 0.812, separately, which are better than Decision Tree and Gradient Boosting Decision Tree, while the key influencing factors analyzed according to the feature importance of XGBoost are mechanical equipment factors, speed, etc.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Prediction Method Based on Hybrid Adaptive Graph Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Aiming at the problems that the explicit graph structure in the short-time traffic flow prediction model does not necessarily reflect the real dependency relationship and cannot effectively discriminate the high-frequency information in the short-time sequence, a novel traffic flow prediction approach leveraging a hybrid adaptive graph convolutional network is introduced. Firstly, a spatial information extraction module that can obtain different relationship features among nodes is introduced, which is used to solve the problem of too single spatial information extraction. Secondly, a temporal convolution module with local high-frequency information extraction is proposed to better identify the high-frequency effects in the traffic flow. Lastly, the spatial and temporal extraction modules are connected in parallel to form the spatiotemporal network layer, which is finally connected to the output layer to obtain the prediction. Three real traffic datasets are used for the experiments, and compared with the existing mainstream models, the MAE, RMSE, and MAPE indexes have been improved by an average of 4.480%,3.744%, and 1.913%. It fully demonstrates that the method in this paper is effective for short-term traffic flow prediction.

articleTitle: Freeze-Dried Tablets Based on YOLOv8 Research on Automatic Detection Technology of Surface Defects
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that freeze-dried tablets have many kinds of scars due to their special low-pressure preparation method, and the number of defective products is small due to strict environmental requirements, and the requirements for detection performance are high, and the traditional defect detection algorithm can not meet the industry requirements, an improved YOLOv8-based surface defect detection algorithm for freeze-dried tablets is proposed. Firstly, a modified lightweight CPU network PP-LCNet is introduced on the basis of YOLOv8 network model to improve the operation speed of the model. Secondly, the attention mechanism module CBAM is integrated into the feature extraction network structure to extract information from two dimensions: space and channel, so as to improve the accuracy and algorithm stability of feature extraction of small target freeze-dried tablets. The problem of insufficient information of small targets and the accuracy of the model are solved. Compared with YOLOv8, the accuracy, recall and average accuracy of mAP0.5 increased by 7.9, 12.3 and 4.7 percentage points respectively through the self-made freeze-dried tablets data set detection experiment.

articleTitle: Enhancing Medical Image Segmentation with a Lightweight Boundary-Aware Multitask Detection Head
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Medical image segmentation is a pivotal technology for improving diagnostic accuracy and treatment outcomes and is critical for accurate lesion localization. Deep learning methods have become a significant tool for processing complex biomedical image data and have contributed significantly to the development of imaging segmentation techniques. However, ambiguous object boundaries and finite annotated samples tend to restrict the best performance of the models. To overcome these challenges, in this paper, we present a novel plug-and-play lightweight boundary-aware multitask detection head to improve the segmentation performance of deep learning models. Specifically, this module integrates Boundary Detection and Signed Distance Map as auxiliary tasks to efficiently utilize the pixel-level annotation information, which significantly improves the ability of the deep learning models to recognize and precisely delineate target boundaries, thereby enhancing segmentation performance. The experiments on two public segmentation datasets demonstrated that our proposed detection head outperforms traditional segmentation heads in the evaluation metrics with a slight increase in model parameters. These results not only verify the efficacy of our proposed model in improving the accuracy of boundary detection but also provide valuable insights for achieving more accurate medical image segmentation using deep learning models.

articleTitle: A Secure Encryped Communication System Design Based on Reconfigurable Hardware
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, data security has become the focus of people's attention. Encryption technology is an important means to ensure data security. However, for edge hardware that is widely used today, using software to implement data encryption and decryption can no longer meet its low-latency and high-reliability application requirements. Based on the principles of symmetric encryption algorithm and asymmetric encryption algorithm, this paper designs hardware IP based on RSA, DES, and ASCON encryption algorithms and mounts them on PicoRV32 to implement SoC (System on Chip) with built-in security encryption function. This paper implements a secure encryption SoC based on the reconfigurable hardware chip GW2A, and A Server-Client secure encrypted communication test platform was built. After testing, the Server-Client encryption communication system ran well. At the same frequency, compared with the software implementation, the hardware implementation calculation speed increased by more than 4 times. The security encryption system based on reconfigurable hardware designed in this paper has the characteristics of high flexibility, strong security, and fast response, and has certain reference value in Internet of Things communication security applications.

articleTitle: Real-time Classification Study of Natural Earthquake and Artificial Blasting Waveforms Based on QRCN
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The classification and recognition of natural earthquakes and artificial explosions constitute a pivotal technology under the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT), vital for safeguarding national security. However, as the number of artificial explosions rises, failure to promptly identify and eliminate these events could compromise seismic catalogs and future seismological research. Currently, most classification research focuses on full-band analysis, with limited exploration in real-time classification. To facilitate real-time identification and classification of natural earthquakes and artificial explosions, we introduce a sliding window strategy and QRCN as effective solutions to this intricate task. In this study, we selected 445 natural seismic events and 430 artificial blasting events from the region surrounding Beijing's capital circle. We extracted the three-component waveform of each station, meticulously screening out effective waveforms undistorted by noise. Employing a sliding window strategy, we detected the source waveform in real-time and intercepted the bands meeting the specified criteria for normalization. Utilizing QRCN, we conducted feature extraction and waveform classification and recognition on the processed data bands. Recognition was performed on a per-event basis. When compared to models like SVM, ResNet18, ResNet50, ViT (Vision Transformer), and Swin Transformer V2, our approach exhibited a significant improvement in accuracy.

articleTitle: Handover Scheme Based on Skip Probability in Heterogeneous Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the explosive growth of smart devices and internet applications, user demand for data transmission rates and service quality is growing rapidly. Heterogeneous networks, capable of providing higher data rates and higher network throughput, remain one of the key technologies for next-generation mobile communications. However, in a heterogeneous network, mobile users will incur frequent handovers, which increase system signaling overhead. How to solve the problem of frequent handovers generated by users in heterogeneous networks has become a major concern for handover management. In this paper, a handover approach based on a 1/2 probability skip is proposed in heterogeneous network scenarios. This approach determines whether users skip to micro base stations based on the skip probability, reducing the frequency of user handovers in the system. Simulation investigates changes in user Signal-to-Interference-plus-Noise Ratio (SINR) and handover rates under this approach, demonstrating a 0.07% reduction in handover rate while sacrificing a certain SINR basis.

articleTitle: Bi-Directional Adaptive Gradient Slime Mould Algorithm for Global Optimization and Engineering Application Problems
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Slime mould algorithm (SMA) is an emerging metaheuristic optimization algorithm with good global exploration capability. However, it still needs to solve the problems of fast local optimal solutions and slow convergence speed in Addressing global optimization and engineering application issues. Therefore, this study proposes an improved bi-directional adaptive gradient slime mould algorithm (BAGSMA), which improves SMA in three aspects. BAGSMA uses adaptive gradient as a local search engine and takes the current best solution serving as the reference point of local search, which can effectively jump over the limitations of the local best solution and enhance the precision of the algorithm's convergence. Adding a nonlinear convergence factor to the SMA improves the slime mould location update formula to attain equilibrium between the capacities for exploration and exploitation. A bi-directional search strategy (BDS) is used, which can accelerate the search process and enhance the pace of convergence. Finally, the performance of BAGSMA is evaluated by the CEC2017 test function set, and optimization problems for engineering application. The empirical findings demonstrate the efficacy of BAGSMA, through the synergy of the three improvement strategies, has significant advantages Regarding the aspects of convergence precision, speed, and stability over SMA and the latest swarm intelligence optimization algorithms in global optimization and engineering application problems.

articleTitle: Multi-View Stereo Matching Algorithm Based on Dynamic Patches
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: Existing multi-view 3D reconstruction methods based on PatchMatch encounter issues due to fixed patches, which limit the receptive field and lead to matching ambiguities in occluded areas. To address this issue, a dynamic patch matching method is proposed. This method first extends the field of view to all four quadrants, enhancing the reliable information within the receptive field, thus dynamically adjusting the size and shape of patches to adapt to changes in the scene. Secondly, it evaluates confidence based on geometric consistency and local coherence. Finally, experiments conducted on datasets such as historical buildings, ETH3D, and Tanks and Temples confirm the accuracy and completeness of our method.

articleTitle: An Effective Prediction Method of Physical Fitness for College Students Based on GWO-GRU Model
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: With the increasing awareness of social health, Testing college students' physical fitness has gained a lot of attention as a crucial tool for assessing their physical fitness. Physical fitness tests may encourage college students to engage in sports training and practice good health habits. Currently, the process of calculating physical fitness examination results is highly intricate, and the majority of these approaches rely on manual calculation techniques that are not precise enough to let students grasp physical changes on their own. Therefore, this article adopts the Grey Wolf optimistic (GWO) to optimize the parameters of the Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) neural network, in order to constructs a physical fitness score prediction model based on hyperparameter adaptive optimization. The research used historical college student physical measurement data as its experimental input and used GWO-GRU neural network to build the model framework to achieve more accurate grade prediction. The experimental results show that the prediction method based on GWO-GRU model offers more stability and forecast accuracy than conventional techniques, making it a dependable resource for managing student health at colleges and teaching physical education.

articleTitle: MPCFormer: A Multi-Scale Positional-Channel Attention-Driven MaskFormer
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: This paper presents a novel segmentation model to address the limitations of existing zero-shot semantic segmentation models in handling global semantic understanding and small object segmentation. Zero-shot semantic segmentation aims to segment objects in a photo, which model doesn't encounter in the training stage. We identify the bottleneck of previous zero-shot models in insufficient segmentation of small-scale objects and large-scale objects with complex local features. Recent zero-shot segmentation tasks have been divided into two stages: the first stage generates mask proposals, and the second stage performs zero-shot classification. We use MaskFormer [3] for the first stage and CLIP [10] for the second stage. Our main contributions are: (1) We use a pyramid strategy to improve the feature extraction of small objects; (2) We employ a Positional-Channel Attention to construct the relation between two pixels with long distance. Comprehensive experiments illustrate that our contributions achieve competitive outcomes in zero-shot segmentation tasks relative to existing approaches. Notably, our approach achieves a mIoU of 21.1% on the ADE20k (150 categories) [15]. This performance, conducted under a cross-dataset setting, surpasses the highest results of all compared models with the same backbone by 2.3%.

articleTitle: Application of Hyperbolic Space Attention Mechanisms in 3D Point Cloud Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: A novel 3D point cloud classification method, Point Hyperbolic Geodesic Transformer (PHGT), is proposed in this paper, utilizing the Poincaré ball model of hyperbolic space to enhance the feature extraction and classification processes of point cloud data. The expansive nature and exponential volume-diameter relationship of hyperbolic space, in comparison to traditional Euclidean space and manifolds, demonstrate advantages in managing data with complex hierarchical structures. In PHGT, the model's ability to recognize and process hierarchical structures is enhanced through the use of geodesic distances in hyperbolic space, replacing traditional dot product operations. Extensive experiments have been conducted on the standard datasets ModelNet40 and ScanObjectNN, verifying the effectiveness of PHGT in 3D point cloud classification. Results indicate that PHGT surpasses existing methods based on traditional manifold spaces in terms of classification accuracy and generalization capability. This study not only highlights the potential application of hyperbolic space in handling complex point cloud data but also offers valuable insights for the integration of hyperbolic geometry into other complex data analysis tasks in the future.

articleTitle: Carbon Content Prediction of Converter Steelmaking End-Point Based on Hybrid Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The endpoint prediction model for converter steelmaking is particularly important for achieving the carbon content at the endpoint. In order to accurately predict the end carbon content of steel, the maximum relevance and Minimum redundancy (mRMR) algorithm, which is simple and easy to process high-dimensional data, is introduced for feature selection, and key factors affecting the end carbon content are screened out as input to the model. An improved Pelican optimization algorithm (MPOA) is proposed to optimize the hyperparameters of hybrid core Extreme Learning Machine (HKELM). Then, the prediction model of mRMR-MPOA-HKELM is constructed and compared with the prediction results of HKELM and MPOA-HKELM. The mean absolute error of mRMR-MPOA-HKELM model is 0.012447, the root mean square error is 0.017671, and the coefficient of determination is 0.92007. The accuracy rate of the prediction error of the end carbon content reaches 93% within ±0.02%, which is more accurate than the other two models.

articleTitle: Research on Voice Communication Enhancement of Network Learning Platform Based on Human-Computer Intelligent Interaction
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to improve the resource dispatching performance of network learning platform and enhance the ability of voice communication enhancement of network learning platform, a voice communication enhancement model of network learning platform based on human-computer intelligent interaction is proposed. The resource allocation method of high concurrent access requests is adopted to conduct channel vertical switching processing of voice communication. An optimal control model of voice communication of network learning platform is established with network congestion degree and user data transmission rate as constraint objective parameters. Through artificial intelligence interaction and adaptive control, combined with multi-objective optimization switching and analysis, the comprehensive benefit value is obtained to realize voice communication enhancement. Experiments show that the method used for processing voice communication enhancement of network learning platform can improve communication stability, reduce output interference and improve the ability of resource adaptive allocation of English network learning platform.

articleTitle: Hybrid Optimization Algorithm of Differential Evolution Algorithm and Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: In order to make full use of the advantages of artificial bee colony algorithm (ABC) and differential evolution algorithm (DE), a hybrid optimization algorithm based on differential evolution algorithm and artificial bee colony algorithm (HODEABC) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, we improve the strategy of the DE and ABC algorithm, utilizing two strategies based on the neighborhood information and the whole population information to adapt the strategy according to the improvement rate. Secondly, we employ a hybrid algorithm based on population division to evaluate performance based on the accumulated fitness value, and allocate more computing resources to algorithms demonstrating superior performance. Finally, compared with the improved algorithm on the CEC2014 test set and 22 standard function test sets, the results show that the performance of the proposed algorithm is comparable to these improved algorithms.

articleTitle: Channel Modeling and Performance Analysis of Underwater Wireless Optical Communication System
publicationTitle: 2024 6th International Conference on Communications, Information System and Computer Engineering (CISCE)
abstract: The underwater optical communication channel has volatile and variable characteristics, which makes it difficult to model it quickly and accurately by traditional modelling methods. In order to address this issue, this paper proposes a UWOC system model based on convolutional neural networks (CNN) and autoencoder (AE) neural networks. A deep learning-related technique is applied to the model, resulting in an improvement in the feature extraction and generalisation abilities of traditional AE neural networks for one-dimensional input sequences through the use of one-dimensional convolutional kernel operations. The architecture has the following characteristics: strong generalisation, feature learning ability, fast training convergence of CNN. Furthermore, the Monte Carlo simulation calculation method and EGG model are employed as a means of optimising system performance. The results demonstrate that, under identical circumstances, the system designed in this paper exhibits a lower bit error rate (BER) across a range of signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) in comparison to the communication performance of other UWOC systems.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Possibility for a Wider Range of the Discount Factor for Reinforcement Learning
